一粒质量极其密集的微小粒子在魔法作用下扩展为引力奇点，将生物拉向自身，并在空间上压缩被移入其中的生物。你在一个未被任何生物占据的5尺方格内创造一个奇点。法术施放时，奇点周围@Template[type:emanation|distance:50]内的所有生物和未被固定的物体，根据其反射豁免结果向奇点移动（见下文）。生物和物体从距离奇点最近者开始移动，因此它们可能挡住随后被拉入的其他生物和物体的路径。

生物的空间可以在包含奇点的方格内重叠。进入奇点或在其中结束其回合的生物或物体受到10d10钝击伤害，无法豁免。在奇点内，生物除了对抗你的法术DC尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{脱逃}之外，无法采取任何动作。法术结束时，奇点消失，重叠的生物被移至最近的未占用空间，具体由GM决定。

对于向远离奇点方向移动的生物，弥漫区域内的方格是困难地形；向奇点靠近的生物每花费5尺移动距离，便可移动10尺。

施放法术时位于区域内，以及在区域内结束其回合的生物，需要尝试一次反射豁免。

成功该生物被拉向奇点10尺。

失败该生物被拉向奇点20尺。

大失败该生被拉向奇点30尺。

模组原文:
A tiny particle of incredibly dense mass magically blossoms into a gravitational singularity that pulls creatures toward it and spatially compresses any creatures that are moved into it. You create a singularity in a 5-foot square that is unoccupied by any creatures. All creatures and unsecured objects in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:50] around the singularity are moved toward the singularity when the spell is cast, depending on their Reflex save (see below). Creatures and objects are moved starting with those closest to the singularity, so they might block the path of other creatures and objects that are pulled in later.

Creatures' spaces can overlap in the square that contains the singularity. A creature or object that enters the singularity or ends its turn there takes 10d10 bludgeoning damage with no saving throw. While in the singularity, a creature can take no actions except to attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} against your Spell DC. When the spell ends, the singularity disappears, and overlapping creatures are moved to the closest unoccupied space, as determined by the GM.

Squares in the emanation are difficult terrain for creatures moving away from the singularity, and creatures moving toward the singularity can move 10 feet for each 5 feet of movement they spend.

A creature needs to attempt a Reflex save if it's in the area when the spell is cast and when it ends its turn in the area.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is pulled 10 feet toward the singularity.

Failure The creature is pulled 20 feet toward the singularity.

Critical Failure The creature is pulled 30 feet toward the singularity.

这些宝石是阿兹兰特星际帝国（Azlanti Star Empire）的常见物品，也是冒险者和富裕收藏家青睐的身份象征。尽管外形和功能多种多样，据说这些石头全都是异界存在在远古时代建造物质宇宙（Universe）时使用的水晶工具的碎片。

当你绑定其中一颗精确切割的水晶时，石头不会戴在身上，而会环绕头部运转（若你没有头部，则环绕身体另一处可见部位）。你可以收起一颗 万古石 ，使用一个交互动作；正在环绕的石头也能被从空中夺走，只需成功进行一次 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{缴械} 动作，以你为目标。收起或取下的石头仍保持绑定，但其效果 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF] ，直到你让它再次环绕头部。

有多种类型的 万古石，每种都有不同外观和魔法效果。每个 万古石 插入特定物品后还会获得共鸣能力，例如具有万古特征的武器，或名为以下名称的古老魔法装置： 寻路石.

这块含有云雾状杂质的深蓝色棱柱轻如羽毛。其共鸣能力为你的特技检定提供+1物品加值。

模组原文:
Staple items within the Azlanti Star Empire, these gemstones are popular status symbols for adventurers and wealthy collectors. Despite their myriad forms and functions, these stones are purportedly all fragments of crystal tools used by otherworldly entities to build the Universe in ancient times.

When you invest one of these precisely shaped crystals, the stone orbits your head (or another visible part of your anatomy if you don't have a head) instead of being worn on your body. You can stow an aeon stone with an Interact action, and an orbiting stone can be snatched out of the air with a successful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} action against you. 名为奥斯克瑞斯的恐怖战争机器，仅见于与先驱者相关的古老遗迹之中。其形态如两座叠置的金字塔，内部蕴藏着成分未知的白色能量核心。这些战争机器惯常在战场上瞬移穿梭，令敌人怒火中烧。这些战争机器最初被发现独自游荡于阿巴隆的先驱者城市中，后来在协约世界之外的地点被辨认出来，这为先驱者在宇宙中的扩张活动的理论提供了佐证。

奥斯克瑞斯拒绝正面交锋，始终与敌人保持距离，释放出耀眼的能量光束，将那些不幸与之交战者的肢体切断。它们以极远距离的精准攻击，将敌人一点点肢解。若被迫近身作战，它们能释放时间能量冲击波减缓攻击者，从而争取时间重新调整位置，继续实施肢解轰炸。

如同其他先驱者的构装体，这些守卫拒绝交流，并抵御着几乎所有试图覆盖或破解其程序的尝试。星系中部分顶尖智者曾成功暂时突破奥斯克瑞斯内部的精密程序，但此类入侵行为总会被迅速探测并击退，表明每台这种奇怪机器内部都栖息着不断进化的智能。

当从多个角度发起攻击时，便能轻易压倒奥斯克瑞斯的探测网格与反应机制。新械族学者认为，这些构装体原本是为对抗仅擅长二维作战的敌人而打造的，尽管奥斯克瑞斯自身具备卓越的三维作战能力，它们却始终以敌人仅能二维作战的方式进行战斗。

据推测，奥斯克瑞斯采用的独特战术与武器，旨在应对一种特定威胁：来自平面国度（Planashar Dominion）的平面族（planashars）。平面族来自名为“无限循环”（Infinite Loop）的仅有二维的不同现实。近期他们悄然入侵星系，自称“聚合派”（Those Who Converge），袭击阿巴隆的先驱者城市及太阳聚居地诺玛（Noma）。奥斯克瑞斯专为对抗平面族而生，这一事实更印证了先驱者与平面族之间存在某种关联。

由于奥斯克瑞斯习惯于对抗仅存在于二维空间的生物，它对涉及三维空间的战术显得格外脆弱——例如多角度攻击。尽管奥斯克瑞斯无法完全理解此类战术，但它能感知到自己正被三维思维所牵制，并会利用强大的瞬移能力，在每次机会出现时迅速转移至更安全的位置。

模组原文:
The menacing war machines known as the oscriss are found only in the ancient sites associated with the First Ones. Resembling two stacked pyramids with a white energy core of unknown composition, oscriss infuriate foes by routinely teleporting across the battlefield. Found wandering alone throughout Aballon's First One cities, the war machines were later identified in locations outside the Pact Worlds, lending credence to theories of the First Ones' expansion efforts throughout the cosmos.

The oscriss defy proper engagement, staying far away from their foes and unleashing coruscating beams of energy that slice off the limbs of those unlucky enough to engage with them. They meticulously render their foes apart at extreme range using pinpoint accuracy. If pressured into a close-range engagement, they can unleash a blast of chronal energy to slow their attackers and allow themselves the time to better reposition and continue their dismembering bombardment.

Like other constructs of the First Ones, these guardians refuse to communicate and defy almost all attempts to override or hack their programming. Some of the galaxy's finest minds have managed to temporarily overcome the intricate programming within the oscriss, though such intrusions are quickly detected and repelled, indicating that an evolving intelligence dwells within each of the strange machines.

When engaged at multiple vectors, it becomes easy to overwhelm an oscriss's detection grid and reactions. Anacite scholars propose that the constructs were fashioned to battle foes who engaged strictly in two-dimensional warfare, and while the oscriss themselves are exceptionally capable of acting in three dimensions, they battle as though their foes could engage them only in two.

It's speculated that the unique tactics and weapons employed by the oscriss are intended to deal with one specific threat: the planashars of the Planashar Dominion. The planashars hail from a different reality known as the Infinite Loop that has only two dimensions. They've recently slowly begun invading the galaxy, taking on the title of Those Who Converge and attacking Aballonian First Ones cities and the solar settlement of Noma. That the oscriss are intended to battle them only provides more evidence of some connection between the planashars and the First Ones.

Because the oscriss are accustomed to fighting beings that exist only in two-dimensional space, they're vulnerable to tactics involving three dimensions—attacking from multiple angles, for example. While an oscriss doesn't entirely understand such tactics, they can sense when they're being outmaneuvered with three-dimensional thinking and use their potent teleportation abilities to move into a less vulnerable position at every opportunity.

生物的空间可以在包含奇点的方格内重叠。进入奇点或在其中结束其回合的生物或物体受到10d10钝击伤害，无法豁免。在奇点内，生物除了对抗你的法术DC尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{逃脱}之外，无法采取任何动作。法术结束时，奇点消失，重叠的生物被移至最近的未占用空间，具体由GM决定。

对于向远离奇点方向移动的生物，弥漫区域内的方格是困难地形；向奇点靠近的生物每花费5尺移动距离，便可移动10尺。

施放法术时位于区域内，以及在区域内结束其回合的生物，需要尝试一次反射豁免。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物被拉向奇点10尺。

失败该生物被拉向奇点20尺。

大失败该生被拉向奇点30尺。
模组原文:
A tiny particle of incredibly dense mass magically blossoms into a gravitational singularity that pulls creatures toward it and spatially compresses any creatures that are moved into it. You create a singularity in a 5-foot square that is unoccupied by any creatures. All creatures and unsecured objects in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:50] around the singularity are moved toward the singularity when the spell is cast, depending on their Reflex save (see below). Creatures and objects are moved starting with those closest to the singularity, so they might block the path of other creatures and objects that are pulled in later.

Creatures' spaces can overlap in the square that contains the singularity. A creature or object that enters the singularity or ends its turn there takes 10d10 bludgeoning damage with no saving throw. While in the singularity, a creature can take no actions except to attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} against your Spell DC. When the spell ends, the singularity disappears, and overlapping creatures are moved to the closest unoccupied space, as determined by the GM.

Squares in the emanation are difficult terrain for creatures moving away from the singularity, and creatures moving toward the singularity can move 10 feet for each 5 feet of movement they spend.

A creature needs to attempt a Reflex save if it's in the area when the spell is cast and when it ends its turn in the area.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is pulled 10 feet toward the singularity.

Failure The creature is pulled 20 feet toward the singularity.

Critical Failure The creature is pulled 30 feet toward the singularity.

你在触碰的一件无人持有的物体（或你正持有的物体），与该物体接触的另一件物体或表面之间建立分子键。要将物体从该表面拉开，需要成功通过一次对抗你法术DC的[[/act force-open]]{运动}检定，以@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{破开}。

如果你选择接触一个没被占据的五尺方格，则该表面会充满黏附的魔法。该空间将变成高等困难地形。
Chinese:
你在触碰的一件无人持有的物体（或你正持有的物体），与该物体接触的另一件物体或表面之间建立分子键。要将物体从该表面拉开，需要成功通过一次对抗你法术DC的[[/act force-open]]{运动}检定，以@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{破拆}。

如果你选择接触一个没被占据的五尺方格，则该表面会充满黏附的魔法。该空间将变成高等困难地形。
模组原文:
You create a molecular bond between an unattended object you touch (or an object you're holding) and another object or surface that object is touching. Pulling the object free of that surface requires a successful [[/act force-open]]{Athletics} check against your spell DC to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{Force Open}.

If you instead touch one unoccupied 5-foot square, that surface becomes charged with adhering magic. That space becomes greater difficult terrain.

模组原文: An online community moderated by an emvermod never experiences random bugs or downtime. Any checks to @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.Yn4jLPVWVE1vtAaF], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.rmwa3OyhTZ2i2AHl]{Craft} virtual items, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.QyzlsLrqM0EEwd7j]{Earn Income}, or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.RF8xNJ8QsMwogerB] using the community as a tool receive a +2 circumstance bonus. If the emvermod is unfriendly, such checks take a –2 circumstance penalty instead. An emvermod must spend a week in an online space to become a moderator.

previousChinese:
这些宝石是阿兹兰特星际帝国（Azlanti Star Empire）的常见物品，也是冒险者和富裕收藏家青睐的身份象征。尽管外形和功能多种多样，据说这些石头全都是异界存在在远古时代建造物质宇宙（Universe）时使用的水晶工具的碎片。

当你绑定其中一颗精确切割的水晶时，石头不会戴在身上，而会环绕头部运转（若你没有头部，则环绕身体另一处可见部位）。你可以收起一颗 万古石 ，使用一个交互动作；正在环绕的石头也能被从空中夺走，只需成功进行一次 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{缴械} 动作，以你为目标。收起或取下的石头仍保持绑定，但其效果 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF] ，直到你让它再次环绕头部。

有多种类型的 万古石，每种都有不同外观和魔法效果。每个 万古石 插入特定物品后还会获得共鸣能力，例如具有万古特征的武器，或名为以下名称的古老魔法装置： 寻路石.

这个带有珍珠光泽、末端渐细的圆筒，会在你最需要时提供一口空气。你的屏息时间延长为两倍，且在对抗吸入型毒素的豁免上获得+1物品加值。其共鸣之力让你能够施放 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.ShwUELLERVMtdjwE] ，作为每天一次的神术天生法术。

模组原文:
Staple items within the Azlanti Star Empire, these gemstones are popular status symbols for adventurers and wealthy collectors. Despite their myriad forms and functions, these stones are purportedly all fragments of crystal tools used by otherworldly entities to build the Universe in ancient times.

When you invest one of these precisely shaped crystals, the stone orbits your head (or another visible part of your anatomy if you don't have a head) instead of being worn on your body. You can stow an aeon stone with an Interact action, and an orbiting stone can be snatched out of the air with a successful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} action against you. A stowed or removed stone remains invested, but its effects are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF] until you return it to orbit your head again.

There are various types of aeon stones, each with a different appearance and magical effect. Each aeon stone also gains a resonant power when slotted into specific items, such as weapons with the aeon trait or antique magical devices called wayfinders.

This nacreous, tapered cylinder provides a breath of air when you need it most. You can hold your breath for twice as long, and you gain a +1 item bonus to saves against inhaled poisons. The resonant power allows you to cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.ShwUELLERVMtdjwE] as a divine innate spell once per day.

Chinese: 此护甲经过特殊的隔绝处理，以防护特定类型的伤害。你获得对酸蚀、寒冷、电击或火焰的抗力15。制造者在制作此强化模块时选择伤害类型。一套护甲可以安装多个能量屏障强化模块，但每个模块必须提供对不同伤害类型的抗力。
模组原文: This armor is specially treated with insulation to protect against a specific type of damage. You gain resistance 15 to acid, cold, electricity, or fire. The crafter chooses the damage type when creating the upgrade. Multiple energy shielding upgrades can be placed into a suit of armor, but each must provide resistance to a different damage type.

These protruding spikes give armor an aggressive appearance. When you take energy damage, the spikes become charged with that energy type until the next time they're Activated (even if the damage was completely prevented by resistance).

Activate—Impale f

Frequency once per round

Trigger Your turn begins

Requirements You're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, or swallowed by a creature or have a creature grabbed or restrained

Effect You deal @Damage[2d4[untyped]] damage to the required creature. This damage is piercing unless the spikes are charged with an energy type, in which case you can have them deal damage of that type instead.

效果 你造成 @Damage[2d4[untyped]] 伤害，施加给规定的生物。此伤害为穿刺伤害，除非尖刺已充入某种类型的能量；在这种情况下，你可以改为让它们造成该类型的伤害。

previousChinese:
该金属圆筒内填充了隔音材质，能够减少火器发出的噪音。火器开火时不会发出巨大的噪音。不过，被子弹命中的生物还是有可能会因为痛苦而喊叫出声。

战术型消音器是具有魔法和科技特征的混合物品。经由战术型消音器发射的射击会以魔法压低周围的声音。打击大成功时，目标变得无法发声。目标不能使用音波攻击，也不能使用具有听觉特征的动作。这也会阻止目标施法，因为施法需要吟诵或发声，但具有晦匿特征的法术除外。目标可以通过成功的以下豁免抵抗消音器的效果： @Check[will|dc:27] 豁免。
Chinese:
该圆筒内部设有隔音挡板，以降低噪音。火器开火时不会发出巨大的噪音。不过，被子弹命中的生物还是有可能会因为痛苦而喊叫出声。

战术型消音器是具有魔法和科技特征的混合物品。经由战术型消音器发射的射击会以魔法压低周围的声音。打击大成功时，目标变得无法发声。目标不能使用音波攻击，也不能使用具有听觉特征的动作。这也会阻止目标施法，因为施法需要吟诵或发声，但具有晦匿特征的法术除外。目标可以通过成功的以下豁免抵抗消音器的效果： @Check[will|dc:27] 豁免。
模组原文:
A cylinder is filled with internal sound baffles to reduce noise. The weapon doesn't make a loud noise when fired. However, creatures hit by the ammunition might still cry out in pain.

A tactical silencer is a hybrid item with the magical and tech traits. Shots fired from a tactical silencer magically dampen sounds around them. On a critically successful Strike, the target becomes unable to make sound. The target can't use sonic attacks, nor can it use actions with the auditory trait. This also prevents the target from casting spells due to the incantations or sounds involved in casting, with the exception of subtle spells. The target can resist the effects of the silencer with a successful @Check[will|dc:27] save.

previousChinese: 安装在腰带或肢体绑带上的全息投影器可以用一个交互动作启动。你可将其设定为投射出与你体型类别相同的另一生物的外观，以隐藏自己的真实外貌。全息皮肤不会改变你的声音、气味或举止。持握和穿戴物品的外观也不受影响。通常你需要用全息皮肤准备伪装，才能 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{假扮} 他人（使用欺骗技能）。

模组原文: A holographic projector mounted to a belt or limb strap can be activated as an Interact action. It can be programmed to project the appearance of another creature of the same size category as yourself, hiding your true appearance. A holoskin doesn't change your voice, scent, or mannerisms. The appearance of held and worn items aren't affected. You usually need a holoskin to set up a disguise in order to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} someone using the Deception skill.

previousChinese:
该装置能改变你护甲上绝缘层的化学成分，使其能响应不同类型的能量。

启动—适应 r

频率每10分钟一次

触发 你受到强酸、寒冷、电击或火焰伤害

效果 你的能量屏蔽强化模块变为触发伤害的类型。此变化持续至你再次适应，或卸下任何一个自适应能量屏蔽或 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment.Item.fQxWOthZx2HZUEzZ]{能量屏障} 强化模块，来自同一件护甲。若此护甲上有多个能量屏蔽强化模块，每次适应时选择其中一个改变。
Chinese:
该装置能改变你护甲上绝缘层的化学成分，使其能响应不同类型的能量。

启动—适应 r

频率每10分钟一次

触发 你受到酸蚀、寒冷、电击或火焰伤害

效果 你的能量屏障强化模块变为触发伤害的类型。此变化持续至你再次适应，或从同一件护甲上卸下任何自适应能量屏障或 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment.Item.fQxWOthZx2HZUEzZ]{能量屏障} 强化模块。若此护甲上有多个能量屏障强化模块，每次适应时选择其中一个改变。
模组原文:
This device changes the chemical composition of the insulation installed on your armor, reacting to different types of energy.

Activate—Adapt r

Frequency once per 10 minutes

Trigger You take acid, cold, electricity, or fire damage

Effect Your energy shielding upgrade changes to the triggering damage type. This lasts until you Adapt again or uninstall any adaptive energy shielding or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment.Item.fQxWOthZx2HZUEzZ]{Energy Shielding} upgrade from the same armor. If you have multiple energy shielding upgrades on this armor, choose one to change when you Adapt.

previousChinese:
容器包含背包，公文箱，行李袋或是手提袋。一个容器最多可容纳4B物品且前2B不计入你的负载。如果你抓着容器或存放容器而非将其穿戴在个人身上，其将有L的负载而非可以忽略不计。

你在检定中获得+1物品加值，用于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{留下印象} ，针对上流社会人士，且你携带着名牌容器，例如名牌手提包。

容器包含背包，公文箱，行李袋或是手提袋。一个容器最多可容纳4B物品且前2B不计入你的负载。如果你抓着容器或存放容器而非将其穿戴在个人身上，其将有L的负载而非可以忽略不计。

你在检定中获得+1物品加值，用于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{建立印象} ，针对上流社会人士，且你携带着名牌容器，例如名牌手提包。
模组原文:
Containers include backpacks, briefcases, duffel bags, and handbags. A container holds up to 4 Bulk and the first 2 Bulk of those items don't count against your Bulk limits. If you're carrying or stowing the container rather than wearing it on your person, its Bulk is light instead of negligible.

You gain a +1 item bonus to checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression} on high society individuals while carrying a designer container, such as a designer handbag.

previousChinese:
这个笨重的黄铜钥匙圈上悬挂着一尊未知外星生物的手工雕像。持握或携带此钥匙圈时，你在用于以下用途的神秘检定上获得+1物品加值： @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{辨识魔法} 和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识}，且你可以施放 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.pwzdSlJgYqN7bs2w]{念动之手} 戏法，作为每天一次的异能天生法术。

注： 物品的负载、价格和用法依据SFS裁定与澄清列出。
Chinese:
这个笨重的黄铜钥匙圈上悬挂着一尊未知外星生物的手工雕像。持握或携带此钥匙圈时，你在用于以下用途的神秘检定上获得+1物品加值： @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{辨识魔法} 和 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{回忆知识}，且你可以施放 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.pwzdSlJgYqN7bs2w]{念动之手} 戏法，作为每天一次的异能内在法术。

注： 物品的负载、价格和用法依据SFS裁定与澄清列出。
模组原文:
A handmade figurine of an unknown alien creature dangles from a clunky brass keyring. While holding or carrying the keyring, you gain a +1 item bonus to Occultism checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify Magic} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, and you can cast the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.pwzdSlJgYqN7bs2w]{Telekinetic Hand} cantrip as an occult innate spell once per day.

Note: The item's Bulk, price and usage are listed according to SFS Rulings and Clarifications.

你还获得30尺范围的嗅觉作为模糊感官，且启动频率变为每天两次。

Chinese:
这组传感器通过安装在头盔上的抬头显示器，提供周围环境的详细信息。

模组原文:
This set of sensors use a helmet-mounted, heads-up display to provide detailed information about your surroundings.

You also gain scent as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet, and the activation's frequency becomes twice per day.

Your hearing additionally becomes a precise sense with a range of 30 feet.

Activate—Scan 1 (manipulate)

Frequency three times per day

Effect You gain tremorsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet for 10 minutes.

Chinese: 商用型充能尖刺 Energized Spikes (Commercial)

previousChinese:
These protruding spikes give armor an aggressive appearance. When you take energy damage, the spikes become charged with that energy type until the next time they're Activated (even if the damage was completely prevented by resistance).

Activate—Impale f

Frequency once per round

Trigger Your turn begins

Requirements You're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, or swallowed by a creature or have a creature grabbed or restrained

Effect You deal @Damage[2d4[untyped]] damage to the required creature. This damage is piercing unless the spikes are charged with an energy type, in which case you can have them deal damage of that type instead.
Chinese:
这些突出的尖刺使护甲显得咄咄逼人。当你受到能量伤害时，尖刺会充入该类型的能量，直到下一次被启动（即使伤害已被抗力完全抵消，也一样）。

启动—穿刺 f

频率 每轮一次

触发 你的回合开始

需求 你处于 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{受擒}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{束缚}，或被生物吞咽，或你已擒住或束缚了一个生物

效果 你造成 @Damage[2d4[untyped]] 伤害，施加给规定的生物。此伤害为穿刺伤害，除非尖刺已充入某种类型的能量；在这种情况下，你可以改为让它们造成该类型的伤害。
模组原文:

Requirements You're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, or swallowed by a creature or have a creature grabbed or restrained

Chinese: 能量屏障（商用型，电击） Energy Shielding (Commercial) (Electricity)

previousChinese: This armor is specially treated with insulation to protect against a specific type of damage. You gain resistance 5 to acid, cold, electricity, or fire. The crafter chooses the damage type when creating the upgrade. Multiple energy shielding upgrades can be placed into a suit of armor, but each must provide resistance to a different damage type.
Chinese: 这套护甲有经过特殊的绝缘处理，可以抵御特定类型的伤害。你在酸蚀、寒冷、电击或火焰上获得5点抗力。制造者在制造强化模块时要选择伤害类型。一套护甲可以放置多个能量屏障，但是每个能量屏障提供的抗力类型必须互不相同。
模组原文: This armor is specially treated with insulation to protect against a specific type of damage. You gain resistance 5 to acid, cold, electricity, or fire. The crafter chooses the damage type when creating the upgrade. Multiple energy shielding upgrades can be placed into a suit of armor, but each must provide resistance to a different damage type.

Chinese: 商用型便捷修补器 Easypatcher (Commercial)

previousChinese:
This upgrade contains tiny robotic arms and sensors to detect injuries. The easy patcher can hold up to two medpatches, which you can install as a 10-minute activity. The medpatch's level must be equal to or less than the easypatcher's level or the armor's level, if it's higher.

Activate—Patch Up 1 (manipulate)

Requirements A medpatch is installed in the easypatcher's compartment

Effect The robotic arms hiss and unfold from the compartment, applying the medpatch to your injuries and replicating the consumed medpatch's effect. The medpatch is consumed.
Chinese:
此强化模块装有微型机械臂和探测伤势的传感器。便捷修补器至多可装两张医疗贴，你可以用一个10分钟的活动将其装入。医疗贴的等级不能高于便捷修补器的等级，或护甲的等级，取二者中较高者。

启动—修补 1 （操作）

需求 便捷修补器的隔舱中装有一张医疗贴

效果 机械臂嘶鸣着从隔间中展开，将医疗贴敷在你的伤处，重现所消耗医疗贴的效果。医疗贴被消耗。
模组原文:
This upgrade contains tiny robotic arms and sensors to detect injuries. The easy patcher can hold up to two medpatches, which you can install as a 10-minute activity. The medpatch's level must be equal to or less than the easypatcher's level or the armor's level, if it's higher.

Activate—Patch Up 1 (manipulate)

Requirements A medpatch is installed in the easypatcher's compartment

Effect The robotic arms hiss and unfold from the compartment, applying the medpatch to your injuries and replicating the consumed medpatch's effect. The medpatch is consumed.

previousChinese: 安装在腰带或肢体绑带上的全息投影器可以用一个交互动作启动。你可将其设定为投射出与你体型类别相同的另一生物的外观，以隐藏自己的真实外貌。全息皮肤不会改变你的声音、气味或举止。持握和穿戴物品的外观也不受影响。通常你需要用全息皮肤准备伪装，才能 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{假扮} 他人（使用欺骗技能）。战术型全息皮肤为相关检定提供+1物品加值。
Chinese: 安装在腰带或肢体绑带上的全息投影器可以用一个交互动作启动。你可将其设定为投射出与你体型类别相同的另一生物的外观，以隐藏自己的真实外貌。全息皮肤不会改变你的声音、气味或举止。持握和穿戴物品的外观也不受影响。通常你需要用全息皮肤准备伪装，才能 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{乔装} 他人（使用欺骗技能）。战术型全息皮肤为相关检定提供+1物品加值。
模组原文: A holographic projector mounted to a belt or limb strap can be activated as an Interact action. It can be programmed to project the appearance of another creature of the same size category as yourself, hiding your true appearance. A holoskin doesn't change your voice, scent, or mannerisms. The appearance of held and worn items aren't affected. You usually need a holoskin to set up a disguise in order to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} someone using the Deception skill. A tactical holoskin adds a +1 item bonus to relevant checks.

previousChinese:
这团绿色黏液看似一团果冻，但戴在头上后，你可以通过交互将其塑造成各种发型。佩戴时，绿色液体会缓缓流进你的耳朵，顺着额头和脖子滴落，长期使用会感到不适。

蜕皮发式 使你在神秘检定中获得+1物品加值，并让你可以施放 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.h7IhypLwItepwhou] 戏法，作为异能天生法术。
Chinese:
这团绿色黏液看似一团果冻，但戴在头上后，你可以通过交互将其塑造成各种发型。佩戴时，绿色液体会缓缓流进你的耳朵，顺着额头和脖子滴落，长期使用会感到不适。

蜕皮发式 使你在神秘检定中获得+1物品加值，并让你可以施放 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.h7IhypLwItepwhou] 戏法，作为异能内在法术。
模组原文:
This wad of green slime looks like a mass of jelly, but when worn on the head, you can Interact to style it into hair-do-like fashions. While worn, rivulets of green liquid slowly dribble into your ears and down your forehead and neck, making it uncomfortable to use long-term.

Slough-do grants you a +1 item bonus to Occultism checks, and allows you to cast the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.h7IhypLwItepwhou] cantrip as an occult innate spell.

Chinese: 商用型漂流引擎中继器 Drift Drive Relay (Commercial)

previousChinese:
This advanced containment unit stores and channels entangled Drift particles, allowing you to briefly flicker into the Drift as you move. When you successfully [[/act tumble-through]] a creature's space, you don't treat its squares as difficult terrain.

As a 10-minute activity, you can attune this armor upgrade to a Drift engine you can physically access to further enhance the relay's abilities.

Activate—Warp 2

Frequency once per day

Requirements You're within planetary range of an attuned, functional Drift engine

Effect You warp through space, gaining the effects of a 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]{Translocate} spell.
Chinese:
这个先进约束单元储存并引导纠缠的漂流粒子，让你移动时能短暂闪入漂流域。当你成功 [[/act tumble-through]] 一个生物的空间时，不将其方格视为困难地形。

你可以用一个10分钟活动，将此护甲强化模块调谐至一台你能实体接触的漂流引擎，进一步增强中继器的能力。

启动—跃迁 2

频率 每天一次

需求 你位于一台已调谐、正常运作的漂流引擎的行星范围内

效果 你穿越空间，获得4环 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]{次元移位} 法术。
模组原文:

Activate—Warp 2

Frequency once per day

Requirements You're within planetary range of an attuned, functional Drift engine

Effect You warp through space, gaining the effects of a 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.VlNcjmYyu95vOUe8]{Translocate} spell.

Chinese:

Upgrades: 1

Tempweave suits are reinforced hooded garments woven with thermal fabric and venting wires, popularly worn for trips to humid climates like the jungles of Castrovel or Pulonis.

previousChinese:
强化： 2

这件战术型 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment.Item.mkMWda6ivlhnXq4d] 兼具时尚与实用。穿戴此护甲时，你的隐秘检定获得+1物品加值，用于 [[/act sneak]] 和 [[/act hide]] ，限城市环境。

This irregular gray torus is pitted and scarred, and it glows green in an environment with at least low levels of radiation, with higher levels causing a more intense glow. In addition to serving as a simple radiation detector, the stone absorbs radiation around the wearer. You gain resistance 8 to poison damage from radiation effects and a +3 status bonus to Fortitude saves against radiation.

Frequency once per day

Effect You unleash a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] centered on you that irradiates the area for 1 hour. Creatures that enter the area must attempt a @Check[fortitude|dc:22] save against severe radiation sickness. This magical radiation has an immediate onset, and the interval between each stage is 1 round.

You get a +1 item bonus to Nature checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.q9nbyIF0PEBqMtYe]{Command an Animal}. If you have a wildwise graft or other way of communicating directly with animals, you also get a +1 item bonus to Diplomacy checks on animals.

previousChinese:
这些宝石是阿兹兰特星际帝国（Azlanti Star Empire）的常见物品，也是冒险者和富裕收藏家青睐的身份象征。尽管外形和功能多种多样，据说这些石头全都是异界存在在远古时代建造物质宇宙（Universe）时使用的水晶工具的碎片。

当你绑定其中一颗精确切割的水晶时，石头不会戴在身上，而会环绕头部运转（若你没有头部，则环绕身体另一处可见部位）。你可以收起一颗 万古石 ，使用一个交互动作；正在环绕的石头也能被从空中夺走，只需成功进行一次 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{缴械} 动作，以你为目标。收起或取下的石头仍保持绑定，但其效果 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF] ，直到你让它再次环绕头部。

有多种类型的 万古石，每种都有不同外观和魔法效果。每个 万古石 插入特定物品后还会获得共鸣能力，例如具有万古特征的武器，或名为以下名称的古老魔法装置： 寻路石.

这块含有云雾状杂质的深蓝色棱柱轻如羽毛。其共鸣能力为你的特技检定提供+1物品加值。

模组原文:
Staple items within the Azlanti Star Empire, these gemstones are popular status symbols for adventurers and wealthy collectors. Despite their myriad forms and functions, these stones are purportedly all fragments of crystal tools used by otherworldly entities to build the Universe in ancient times.

When you invest one of these precisely shaped crystals, the stone orbits your head (or another visible part of your anatomy if you don't have a head) instead of being worn on your body. You can stow an aeon stone with an Interact action, and an orbiting stone can be snatched out of the air with a successful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} action against you. A stowed or removed stone remains invested, but its effects are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF] until you return it to orbit your head again.

There are various types of aeon stones, each with a different appearance and magical effect. Each aeon stone also gains a resonant power when slotted into specific items, such as weapons with the aeon trait or antique magical devices called wayfinders.

This deep-blue prism with cloudy inclusions is light as a feather. Its resonant power gives you a +1 item bonus to Acrobatics checks.

Activate—Fly Free 1 (concentrate)

Frequency once per day

Effect You gain a fly Speed for 1 minute equal to your Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater.

这些宝石是阿兹兰特星际帝国（Azlanti Star Empire）的常见物品，也是冒险者和富裕收藏家青睐的身份象征。尽管外形和功能多种多样，据说这些石头全都是异界存在在远古时代建造物质宇宙（Universe）时使用的水晶工具的碎片。

当你绑定其中一颗精确切割的水晶时，石头不会戴在身上，而会环绕头部运转（若你没有头部，则环绕身体另一处可见部位）。你可以收起一颗 万古石 ，使用一个交互动作；正在环绕的石头也能被从空中夺走，只需成功进行一次 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{缴械} 动作，以你为目标。收起或取下的石头仍保持绑定，但其效果 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF] ，直到你让它再次环绕头部。

有多种类型的 万古石，每种都有不同外观和魔法效果。每个 万古石 插入特定物品后还会获得共鸣能力，例如具有万古特征的武器，或名为以下名称的古老魔法装置： 寻路石.

模组原文:
Staple items within the Azlanti Star Empire, these gemstones are popular status symbols for adventurers and wealthy collectors. Despite their myriad forms and functions, these stones are purportedly all fragments of crystal tools used by otherworldly entities to build the Universe in ancient times.

When you invest one of these precisely shaped crystals, the stone orbits your head (or another visible part of your anatomy if you don't have a head) instead of being worn on your body. You can stow an aeon stone with an Interact action, and an orbiting stone can be snatched out of the air with a successful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} action against you. A stowed or removed stone remains invested, but its effects are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF] until you return it to orbit your head again.

There are various types of aeon stones, each with a different appearance and magical effect. Each aeon stone also gains a resonant power when slotted into specific items, such as weapons with the aeon trait or antique magical devices called wayfinders.

This gold star glitters with joyful energy. Its resonant power allows you to cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.izcxFQFwf3woCnFs]{Guidance} as an occult innate cantrip.

Activate—Cosmic Luck 1 (concentrate, fortune)

Frequency once per day

Trigger You critically fail an attack roll, saving throw, or skill check

Effect You change the critical failure into a failure.

previousChinese:

当你以手雷使用主目标时，该手雷被视同为简易投掷武器，具有耗弹0和区域（爆发）特征，70尺射程（若具有长距离掷弹专长则为140尺）。打击对手雷的主目标造成1个伤害骰的伤害，该伤害骰与手雷具有相同的骰子大小以及伤害类型。若手雷为先进型或卓越型，该伤害会增加至2个伤害骰，精英型或终极型手雷为3个伤害骰，完美型手雷为4个伤害骰。若手雷本身不会造成伤害，那么使用主目标时它也不会造成伤害。

模组原文:
You count grenades as an area weapon with the area (burst) trait for the purposes of all soldier feats and class features, including primary target and suppressing fire. If you're holding a grenade, you meet the requirements for soldier feats that require you to wield an area weapon.

When you use primary target with a grenade, the grenade counts as a simple thrown weapon with expend 0, the area (burst) trait, and a range of 70 feet (or 140 feet if you have the Long Thrower feat). The Strike against the grenade's primary target deals one damage die of the same dice size and damage type dealt by the grenade. This damage increases to two damage dice if the grenade is advanced or superior, to three damage dice if the grenade is elite or ultimate, or to four damage dice if the grenade is paragon. If the grenade doesn't usually deal damage, it doesn't deal damage using primary target.

previousChinese: 你的黏液让你能顽强地抓牢敌人。当你对一个目标进行[[/act grapple]]检定并取得大失败时，改为获得失败结果。此外，被你@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{擒拿}的生物进行脱逃检定时，若失败则改为大失败，若大成功则改为成功。
Chinese: 你的黏液让你能顽强地抓牢敌人。当你对一个目标进行[[/act grapple]]检定并取得大失败时，改为获得失败结果。此外，因你而@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{受擒}的生物进行逃脱检定时，若失败则改为大失败，若大成功则改为成功。
模组原文: Your sticky mucous lets you hang onto foes with a painfully tenacious grip. When you roll a critical failure on a check to [[/act grapple]] a target, you get a failure instead. In addition, when a creature you've @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} rolls a failure on its check to Escape, it gets a critical failure instead, and if it rolls a critical success, it gets a success instead.

特殊如果你使用卓越型或更高级的力场护盾或者盾牌，此次攻击具有追踪+2特征,如果是终极型或更高级的，具有追踪+3特征,相似的，如果是菁英型或更高级的，伤害提升至@Damage[3d10[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage,forced-movement|shortLabel]伤害,如果是完美型提升至@Damage[4d10[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage,forced-movement|shortLabel]。
模组原文:
Requirements You have a force field upgrade in your armor or are holding a tech shield.

You overcharge a shield to create a concussive blast that repulses nearby foes. You @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.actions.Item.oc0ZKnk5zD0GXqZi] using your force field or shield, dealing @Damage[2d10[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage,forced-movement] damage in a @Template[burst|distance:5]{5-foot radius burst} excluding yourself centered on one corner of a square you occupy. This attack has the tracking +1 trait and is in the shield weapon group. A creature that fails its save is pushed back 5 feet. If you have the primary target class feature, the primary target Strike uses your force field or shield.

Special If you're using a force field or shield that's superior or better, the tracking trait increases to +2, or +3 if ultimate or better. Likewise, if it's elite or better, the damage increases to @Damage[3d10[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage,forced-movement|shortLabel], or @Damage[4d10[bludgeoning]|options:area-damage,forced-movement|shortLabel] if paragon.

previousChinese: 你很容易发现全息影像中的微小故障和不完美之处。即使你没有在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]（Searching），你也总可以尝试进行一次检定以尝试识破（disbelieve）全息影像以及通常需要你搜寻或与之互动的带有幻术和科技特征的效果。
Chinese: 你很容易发现全息影像中的微小故障与瑕疵。即使你没有在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜寻}，你也总会尝试检定以识破全息影像，以及那些具有幻术和科技特征、通常要求你搜寻或与其交互才能识破的效果。
模组原文: You easily spot the tiny glitches and imperfections in holograms. Even if you aren't Searching, you always attempt a check to disbelieve holograms and effects with the illusion and tech traits that normally require you to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} or Interact with them.

previousChinese:
频率每天一次

你带着一句神圣的感恩之言喝下一些水，让水将活力导入你的身体。这些水的作用等同于你选择的先进型医疗贴片或皮下注射器。在13级时，其作用等同于卓越型医疗贴片或皮下注射器。在17级时，其作用等同于精英型医疗贴片或皮下注射器。
Chinese:
频率每天一次

你带着一句神圣的感恩之言喝下一些水，让水将活力导入你的身体。这些水的作用等同于你选择的先进型医疗贴片或皮下注射器。在13级时，其作用等同于卓越型医疗贴片或皮下注射器。在17级时，其作用等同于菁英型医疗贴片或皮下注射器。
模组原文:
Frequency once per day

With a sacred word of gratitude, you drink some water and allow it to channel vitality into your body. The water functions as your choice of an advanced medpatch or hypopen. At 13th level, it functions as a superior medpatch or hypopen. At 17th level, it functions as an elite medpatch or hypopen.

previousChinese: 你可以通过摄入更多毒素来增强你的天生毒素，使其与你的天生毒素混合。你交互以取出（如有必要）并喝下你所持握武器中的一剂毒素或一发造成毒素伤害的投射弹药。你下次用你的毒颚进行的打击增加1d4点毒素伤害。如果你持握的武器是先进型或卓越型，伤害增加至两个骰子，如果武器是精英型或终极型，增加至三个骰子，如果是完美型，则增加至四个骰子。重击时，在翻倍武器伤害后骰掷这些骰子。
Chinese: 你可以通过摄入更多毒素来增强你的天生毒素，使其与你的天生毒素混合。你交互以取出（如有必要）并喝下你所持握武器中的一剂毒素或一发造成毒素伤害的投射弹药。你下次用你的毒颚进行的打击增加1d4点毒素伤害。如果你持握的武器是先进型或卓越型，伤害增加至两个骰子，如果武器是菁英型或终极型，增加至三个骰子，如果是完美型，则增加至四个骰子。重击时，在翻倍武器伤害后骰掷这些骰子。
模组原文: You can enhance your natural venom by imbibing more poison, allowing it to mix with your natural poison production. You Interact to draw (if necessary) and chug a dose of poison or one piece of projectile ammunition from a weapon you're holding that deals poison damage. Add 1d4 poison damage to the next Strike you make with your venomous jaws. The damage increases to two dice if your held weapon is advanced grade or superior grade, three dice if the weapon is elite grade or ultimate grade, and four dice if the weapon is paragon grade. On a critical hit, roll these dice after doubling the weapon's damage.

选择一个族裔或传承。你学会该族裔或传承可选的一门新语言。你在社群技能上受训。如果你已经在社群技能上受训，则改为在另一项自选技能上受训。你同时在与该族裔或传承相关的学识技能上受训，例如仿生人学识或鼠族学识。

特殊你可多次选取此专长，每次选择不同族裔或传承。
模组原文:
Choose an ancestry or heritage. You learn a new language available to that ancestry or heritage. You become trained in Society. If you're already trained in Society, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice. You also become trained in the Lore skill related to that specific ancestry or heritage, such as Android Lore or Ysoki Lore.

Special You can select this feat multiple times, choosing a different ancestry or heritage each time.

频率 每日1次

Frequency once per day

You channel your spirit into a mighty barrage from a celestial plasma cannon. Iomedae's barrage Auto-Fires in a @Template[type:cone|distance:15] or a @Template[type:line|distance:30], dealing @Damage[(floor(@actor.level/2 - 1))d6[fire], (floor(@actor.level/2 - 1))d6[spirit]|traits:holy] damage with the holy trait (@Check[type:reflex|dc:resolve(@actor.attributes.classOrSpellDC.value)]). 频率每轮一次

你可以行走并穿过路径上任何生物所处空间。任何你移动穿越空间的与你体型相同或更小的生物，可以尝试一次@Check[reflex|against:athletics]对抗你的运动DC，以避免被包卷。无法行动的生物在此豁免上自动大失败。如果一个生物成功通过其豁免，它可以选择被推到侧面或是在你移动结束时被推到你的前方。你每回合只能尝试粘稠包卷同一生物一次。你能够容纳尽可能多的生物直至填满其占据空间。

豁免失败的生物被拉入你体内。它@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{受擒}且@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{缓慢1}，并且必须屏息，否则开始窒息。被吞没期间，该生物在其每个回合结束时受到@Damage[1d6[acid]]伤害（此伤害可由@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment.Item.b12tnjobe9IrphII]{硬光缠手带}改善，如同徒手攻击）。被吞没的生物可以[[/act escape dc=athletics]]{脱逃}，对抗你的运动DC，以此脱身。被吞没的生物可以攻击你，但只能用徒手攻击或轻量及更轻的武器。你对这些攻击@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及}。如果你在单次攻击或法术中受到的穿刺或挥砍伤害达到或超过你剩余生命值的四分之一，被吞没的生物就会切开你的身体脱身。以任一方式脱身的生物都可以立即呼吸，并离开你的空间。如果你入睡、被打至@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{失去意识}或死亡，你吞没的所有生物都会自动获释。

Frequency once per round

You can Stride and move through spaces of any creatures in your path. Any creature your size or smaller whose space you move through can attempt a @Check[reflex|against:athletics] save against your Athletics DC to avoid being engulfed. A creature unable to act automatically critically fails this save. If a creature succeeds at its save, it can choose to either be pushed aside or pushed in front of you at the end of your movement. You can only attempt to Gooey Engulf the same creature once per turn. You can contain as many creatures as can fit in your space.

A creature that fails its save is pulled into your body. It is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1}, and it must hold its breath or start suffocating. The creature takes @Damage[1d6[acid]] damage at the end of each of its turns while engulfed (this damage can be improved by @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment.Item.b12tnjobe9IrphII]{hardlight handwraps} as though it were an unarmed attack). An engulfed creature can get free by [[/act escape dc=athletics]]{Escaping} against your Athletics DC. An engulfed creature can attack you but only with an unarmed attack or weapons of light Bulk or less. You're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against these attacks. If you take piercing or slashing damage equaling or exceeding one fourth of your remaining Hit Points from a single attack or spell, the engulfed creature cuts itself free. A creature that gets free by either method can immediately breathe and exits your space. If you fall asleep, are knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fBnFDH2MTzgFijKf]{Unconscious}, or die, all creatures you've engulfed are automatically released.

previousChinese: 你构建出更耐久的临时外壳。你用碎@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.JeGhKyXLpV99DxEP]制作的盾牌为战术型品质。你在9级时可以制作先进型盾牌，13级为卓越型盾牌，17级为精英型盾牌。此外，你可以使用废料盾牌来制作一面@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment.Item.n7My3cvLdfygf9xp]。
Chinese: 你构建出更耐久的临时外壳。你用@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.JeGhKyXLpV99DxEP]制作的盾牌为战术型品质。你在9级时可以制作先进型盾牌，13级为卓越型盾牌，17级为菁英型盾牌。此外，你可以使用废料盾牌来制作一面@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment.Item.n7My3cvLdfygf9xp]。
模组原文: You build more durable temporary shells. The shield you create with @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.JeGhKyXLpV99DxEP] is tactical grade. You can create an advanced shield at 9th level, a superior shield at 13th level, and an elite shield at 17th level. In addition, you can use Scrap Shield to create a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment.Item.n7My3cvLdfygf9xp].

previousChinese:
多年玩轻灵狂欢球（skitterspree）的经历让你练就了特殊招式。你紧紧蜷缩成球，一个与你相邻、有一只空闲手且体型至少比你大一级的盟友，可以使用一个反应动作，以你的身体作为无武装攻击尝试一次远程打击；在此次打击期间，该攻击造成1d10钝击伤害。此无武装攻击属于搏击武器组，具有灵巧、模拟、凶暴和投掷（20尺）特征。此无武装攻击会获得你穿戴的@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment.Item.b12tnjobe9IrphII]{硬光缠手带}的好处。你在目标相邻处落地，但如果此次打击大失败，你会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}着地。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.hi8MzgUdx532I1Gt]{效果：人肉炮弹}
Chinese:
多年玩轻灵狂欢球（skitterspree）的经历让你练就了特殊招式。你紧紧蜷缩成球，一个与你相邻、有一只空闲手且体型至少比你大一级的盟友，可以使用一个反应动作，以你的身体作为无武装攻击尝试一次远程打击；在此次打击期间，该攻击造成1d10钝击伤害。此无武装攻击属于搏击武器组，具有灵巧、非电子、凶暴和投掷（20尺）特征。此无武装攻击会获得你穿戴的@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment.Item.b12tnjobe9IrphII]{硬光缠手带}的好处。你在目标相邻处落地，但如果此次打击大失败，你会@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}着地。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feat-effects.Item.hi8MzgUdx532I1Gt]{效果：人肉炮弹}
模组原文:
Years of playing skitterspree trained you for a special move. You curl up into a tightly wound ball, and an adjacent ally with a free hand that's at least one size larger than you can use a reaction to attempt a ranged Strike with your body as an unarmed attack that deals 1d10 bludgeoning damage for the duration of the Strike. This unarmed attack is in the brawling weapon group and has the agile, analog, brutal, and thrown (20 feet) traits. This unarmed attack gains the benefits of your worn @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment.Item.b12tnjobe9IrphII]{hardlight handwraps}. You land adjacent to the target, but you land @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} if the Strike is a critical failure.

previousChinese: 当受到威胁时，你可以迅速@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]并找到一个地方蹲下。你跳跃（Leap），着陆时@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]，并立即采@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]（Take Cover）动作压低身形，获得对远程攻击的高等掩蔽。
Chinese: 当受到威胁时，你可以迅速飞扑，找到可以伏身的地方。你@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{跳跃}，着陆时@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}，随后立即@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{寻找掩蔽}，从而压低身形，获得对远程攻击的高等掩蔽。
模组原文: When threatened, you can quickly take a dive and find somewhere to hunker down. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}, land @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, and immediately @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover}, which allows you to hunker down and gain greater cover against ranged attacks.

You create a molecular bond between an unattended object you touch (or an object you're holding) and another object or surface that object is touching. previousChinese:
尸骸舰队最公开的长期目标，是确立不死生物在协约世界恒星系中的至高地位，让这个星系新的不朽统治者随心所欲地消灭或奴役生者。最终，辉煌的尸骸舰队希望征服整个黛丝娜之径，甚至可能扩张到其他星系。

在规模较小的行动中，尸骸舰队的研究员会试验各种死灵武器，包括木乃伊黄蜂这类不生生物武器。

制造木乃伊黄蜂时，先在蜂巢中熏杀整群黄蜂，再煞费苦心地用神圣纸张逐一包裹，将每只黄蜂制成木乃伊，最后通过邪秽仪式埋葬并重新活化整个蜂巢。

部署后，木乃伊黄蜂会凶残地袭击活物，却忽略不死生物，因此是控制区域和压制敌人的理想武器。

它们还极具攻击性和入侵性。许多地方已经发现木乃伊黄蜂的踪迹，远离位于浩界、制造出它们的尸骸舰队设施。

木乃伊黄蜂巢已部署在古冢及其他尸骸舰队设施。它们也被用作弹药，由破障炮发射或从载具中投出。

危险的研究

木乃伊黄蜂和冻骸的成功研制，使阴险的尸骸舰队科学家更加大胆，试图进一步突破界限，造出更强大的不生武器。少数打入尸骸舰队的理事军间谍传回情报，海军统帅部已准备启动“墓心计划”，试图将虫群组件转化为不死士兵。无论成功与否，这项实验的后果都可能给协约世界带来灾难。

模组原文:
The Corpse Fleet's most overt long-term goal is establishing the supremacy of undeath in the Pact Worlds solar system, with the system's new immortal overlords eradicating or enslaving the living as they see fit. Eventually, the glorious Corpse Fleet hopes to conquer all of Desna's Path, and perhaps expand to other galaxies.

On the smaller scale of operations, Corpse Fleet researchers experiment with necromantic weapons of all kinds, including unliving biological weapons like mummy wasps.

Mummy wasps are created by fumigating wasp swarms inside of their hives and then painstakingly and individually mummifying them in sacred paper wrappings before burying and reviving the whole nest in an unholy ritual.

When deployed, mummy wasps viciously attack living creatures and ignore undead, making them an ideal weapon for zone control and enemy suppression.

They're also incredibly aggressive and invasive. Mummy wasps have been spotted in locations far from the Corpse Fleet facilities in the Vast where they were created.

Mummy wasp nests have been deployed at Barrow and other Corpse Fleet installations. They're also utilized as ammunition, shot out of breaching cannons or hurled from vehicles.

Dangerous Research

The successful engineering of mummy wasps and rigor mortics has emboldened devious Corpse Fleet scientists to push the boundaries even further and create more powerful unliving weapons. Intelligence from the few Steward spies inside the Corpse Fleet indicates that the admiralty is ready to launch Project Gravemind, an effort to convert Swarm components into undead troopers. Succeed or fail, the consequences of such an experiment could be disastrous for the Pact Worlds.

温控编织服以保温面料和散热导线织成，是一种经过加固的兜帽服饰，前往卡斯卓韦或普洛尼斯（Pulonis）的丛林等潮湿气候地区旅行时，穿戴它很流行。
模组原文:
Upgrades: 1

Tempweave suits are reinforced hooded garments woven with thermal fabric and venting wires, popularly worn for trips to humid climates like the jungles of Castrovel or Pulonis.

previousChinese:
附着在你护甲上的推进器使你能够飞行。

启动—飞行 1 （操作）

效果 你启动喷气背包，获得20尺飞行速度。此效应持续1分钟，或直到你将其解除。你可以用一个动作飞行0尺来悬停原处，但你会 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及} （仅在悬停期间）。若你超载，喷气背包无法将你抬起。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.0kP4P73w0PykYkPY]
Chinese:
附着在你护甲上的推进器使你能够飞行。

启动—飞行 1 （操作）

效果 你启动喷射背包，获得20尺飞行速度。此效应持续1分钟，或直到你将其解消。你可以用一个动作飞行0尺来悬停原处，但你会 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{措手不及} （仅在悬停期间）。若你超载，喷射背包无法将你抬起。

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment-effects.Item.0kP4P73w0PykYkPY]
模组原文:
Boosters attached to your armor allow you to fly.

Activate—Fly 1 (manipulate)

Effect You activate a jetpack to gain a fly Speed of 20 feet. This effect lasts for 1 minute or until you Dismiss it. You can use an action to Fly 0 feet to hover in place, but you're @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} while doing so. A jetpack can't lift you if you're encumbered.

模组原文: These contain analgesics, bandages, sterile gauze, and suturing tools necessary for Medicine checks to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.MHLuKy4nQO2Z4Am1]{Administer First Aid}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TC7OcDa7JlWbqMaN]{Treat Disease}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.KjoCEEmPGTeFE4hh]{Treat Poison}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.1kGNdIIhuglAjIp9]{Treat Wounds}. Tactical medical toolkits provide a +1 item bonus to such checks. A medkit is a toolkit.

previousChinese: 凭借魅力，你能够将欺骗对象笼络为你的支持者。当你用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{说谎}动作取得大成功时，目标对你的态度改善一级，如同你用交涉技能@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{改善印象}成功。每次交流，这个效果只会生效一次，如果你用相同结果对多个目标取得大成功，则选择一个生物的态度得到改善。你的谎言必须要透露看似重要的信息、鼓吹自己的地位、或巴结奉承对方，无关紧要的谎言无法起到作用。
Chinese: 凭借魅力，你能够将欺骗对象笼络为你的支持者。当你用@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{说谎}动作取得大成功时，目标对你的态度改善一级，如同你用交涉技能@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{建立印象}成功。每次交流，这个效果只会生效一次，如果你用相同结果对多个目标取得大成功，则选择一个生物的态度得到改善。你的谎言必须要透露看似重要的信息、鼓吹自己的地位、或巴结奉承对方，无关紧要的谎言无法起到作用。
模组原文: Your charm allows you to win over those you lie to. When you get a critical success using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ewwCglB7XOPLUz72]{Lie} action, the target's attitude toward you improves by one step, as though you'd succeeded at using Diplomacy to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.OX4fy22hQgUHDr0q]{Make an Impression}. This works only once per conversation, and if you critically succeed against multiple targets using the same result, you choose one creature's attitude to improve. You must be lying to impart seemingly important information, inflate your status, or ingratiate yourself, which trivial or irrelevant lies can't achieve.

previousChinese: 你很容易发现全息影像中的微小故障和不完美之处。即使你没有在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]（Searching），你也总可以尝试进行一次检定以尝试识破（disbelieve）全息影像以及通常需要你搜寻或与之互动的带有幻术和科技特征的效果。
Chinese: 你很容易发现全息影像中的微小故障与瑕疵。即使你没有在@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{搜寻}，你也总会尝试检定以识破全息影像，以及那些具有幻术和科技特征、通常要求你搜寻或与其交互才能识破的效果。
模组原文: You easily spot the tiny glitches and imperfections in holograms. Even if you aren't Searching, you always attempt a check to disbelieve holograms and effects with the illusion and tech traits that normally require you to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.TiNDYUGlMmxzxBYU]{Search} or Interact with them.

previousChinese: 你的眼部处理器配备了先进的瞄准系统，可以让你更容易地定位你的敌人并读取他们的动作。你可以施展@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Gb7SeieEvd0pL2Eh]{料敌机先}作为1环奥术天生法术，每日一次。
Chinese: 你的眼部处理器配备了先进的瞄准系统，可以让你更容易地定位你的敌人并读取他们的动作。你可以施展@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Gb7SeieEvd0pL2Eh]{料敌机先}作为1环奥术内在法术，每日一次。
模组原文: Your ocular processors are augmented with advanced targeting systems, which allow you to more easily pinpoint your enemy and read their movements. You can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Gb7SeieEvd0pL2Eh]{Sure Strike} once per day as a 1st-rank arcane innate spell.

previousChinese: 磁力靴可以用一个交互动作启动或关闭。激活时，它们使你在用于攀爬金属表面的运动检定上获得+1物品加值；站在金属表面上时，你对抗以下检定的强韧DC或反射DC还会获得+1物品加值： @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{移位}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{冲撞}，或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{绊摔} 你（当你站在金属表面上时）。在零重力区域内，穿戴一双磁力靴时，你可以沿金属表面移动至多你的速度，且不会获得失重状态。
Chinese: 磁力靴可以用一个交互动作启动或关闭。激活时，它们使你在用于攀爬金属表面的运动检定上获得+1物品加值；站在金属表面上时，你对抗以下检定的强韧DC或反射DC还会获得+1物品加值： @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{移位}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{推撞}，或 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{摔绊} 你（当你站在金属表面上时）。在零重力区域内，穿戴一双磁力靴时，你可以沿金属表面移动至多你的速度，且不会获得失重状态。
模组原文: Magboots can be activated or deactivated with an Interact action. While active, they grant you a +1 item bonus to Athletics checks to Climb metal surfaces as well as a +1 item bonus to your Fortitude or Reflex DC against attempts to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.lOE4yjUnETTdaf2T]{Reposition}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} you when you're standing on a metal surface. In areas of zero gravity, while wearing a pair of magboots, you can move your Speed across metal surfaces and don't gain the untethered condition.

previousChinese: 当受到威胁时，你可以迅速@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]并找到一个地方蹲下。你跳跃（Leap），着陆时@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]，并立即采@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]（Take Cover）动作压低身形，获得对远程攻击的高等掩蔽。
Chinese: 当受到威胁时，你可以迅速飞扑，找到可以伏身的地方。你@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{跳跃}，着陆时@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{倒地}，随后立即@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{寻找掩蔽}，从而压低身形，获得对远程攻击的高等掩蔽。
模组原文: When threatened, you can quickly take a dive and find somewhere to hunker down. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}, land @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}, and immediately @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ust1jJSCZQUhBZIz]{Take Cover}, which allows you to hunker down and gain greater cover against ranged attacks.

previousChinese: 安装在腰带或肢体绑带上的全息投影器可以用一个交互动作启动。你可将其设定为投射出与你体型类别相同的另一生物的外观，以隐藏自己的真实外貌。全息皮肤不会改变你的声音、气味或举止。持握和穿戴物品的外观也不受影响。通常你需要用全息皮肤准备伪装，才能 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{假扮} 他人（使用欺骗技能）。

模组原文: A holographic projector mounted to a belt or limb strap can be activated as an Interact action. It can be programmed to project the appearance of another creature of the same size category as yourself, hiding your true appearance. A holoskin doesn't change your voice, scent, or mannerisms. The appearance of held and worn items aren't affected. You usually need a holoskin to set up a disguise in order to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.AJstokjdG6iDjVjE]{Impersonate} someone using the Deception skill.

previousChinese:
仿生人几乎能在任何环境中兴盛，并融入无数文化，因此几乎可以出现在星系的任何地方。许多仿生人对自身起源充满好奇，独自或结伴旅行，寻找有关自身身份和广阔宇宙的各种形而上或物质层面问题的答案。尽管出于人造，仿生人仍然多种多样，很少有个体拥有完全相同的外貌。

如果你想扮演一名踏上自我发现之旅的人造角色，就选择仿生人。

你可能……

  • 尽量避免被他人利用。

  • 试图理解自己在广阔星系中的使命。

  • 根据他人如何对待服务业人员、蓝领劳工、粉丝或宠物来评价他们。

他人可能……

  • 难以解读你的情绪，即使你表达出来也难以理解。

  • 暗中羡慕你不会衰老。

  • 因祖先曾将你的族人当作劳工而抱有某种程度的愧疚。

外貌描述

仿生人是生物机械构装体，通常像身上带有发光电路的类人生物。大多数仿生人都在称为铸造厂的专门诞生场所制造出来。较古老的仿生人类型，例如格拉利昂的仿生人，主要由生物组织构成；现代仿生人的身体则通常包含更多科技组件和合成元素。仿生人需要进食与睡眠，但不会繁殖、不会衰老，也没有与生俱来的性别概念——不过许多仿生人会表达类人生物的性别认同，或在不同性别认同之间自由变化。大多数仿生人在约一个世纪后自愿放弃身体，让新的灵魂入住，这一过程称为更新。

社会

仿生人在造访新地方、结识新朋友时往往比较谨慎。适应之后，他们能够建立紧密的友谊和亲情，接纳自己选择的家人，将整条街区和整个社区视作家园，而非受限于围墙划出的边界。仿生人常常不遗余力地帮助彼此，以及自己选择的家人和社区。大多数仿生人不愿毁坏另一名仿生人的身体，因为他们知道，这样做不仅结束一条生命，也抹去了无数有朝一日可能入住其中的灵魂。

示例姓名

Asha, Blue-17, Celita, Daniv, Emene-3, Era- 4, Flick, Garro, Historia-6, Hope-1, Iseph, Melody, Naga, Olas, Omen, Prime, Ruby-17, Stringer, Twenty Six, Urdun, Verity-3, Yose

信仰

仿生人抱有各种宗教与哲学观点，个体有时会在数十年的生活经历中不断吸收信念与习俗。与精灵和其他长寿物种相似，仿生人看待现实的角度往往不同于短寿生物。许多仿生人耐心地追求目标，制定横跨数十年乃至数百年的计划，希望自己能活着见证结果。自愿迈入生命循环下一阶段的年长仿生人，有时会将目标留给下一个入住其身体的灵魂。

常见典范

探索自己的起源，帮助他人实现长期目标，为未来做出计划

常见禁忌

做出鲁莽或自毁的行为

模组原文:
Androids thrive in nearly any environment and exist as part of countless cultures, meaning they can be found almost anywhere in the galaxy. Many androids are curious about their origins, traveling alone or with others in search of answers to a variety of metaphysical and material questions about their identities and the greater cosmos. Androids are diverse, with few individuals sharing the exact same appearance, despite their manufactured state.

If you want to roleplay a synthetic character on a journey of self-discovery, you should play an android.

You Might...

  • Try to avoid others taking advantage of you.

  • Seek to understand your purpose in the wider galaxy.

  • Judge others based on how they treat service workers, blue-collar laborers, fans, or pets.

Others Probably...

  • Have trouble parsing your emotions or understanding when you express them.

  • Secretly covet your lack of aging.

  • Have some level of guilt for their ancestors' use of your species as laborers.

Physical Description

Androids are biomechanical constructs who typically resemble humanoids with glowing circuitry. Most were created in specialized birthing sites called foundries. Older variants of androids, such as androids on Golarion, were primarily biological, but androids in the modern era usually incorporate more technological components and synthetic elements into their bodies. Androids need to eat and sleep, but they don't reproduce, don't age, and have no innate concept of gender—though many express humanoid gender identities or shift fluidly between them. Most androids voluntarily release their bodies after a century or so, allowing new souls to inhabit them in a process called renewal.

Society

Androids tend to be cautious when visiting new places and meeting new people. Once comfortable, androids can form tight bonds of friendship and kinship, adopting found families, and choosing entire neighborhoods and communities as their home, rather than remaining confined by the boundaries formed by walls. Androids often go out of their way to help one another and their chosen families and communities, and most hesitate to destroy the body of another android, knowing that to do so ends not only one life, but erases the countless other souls who could one day inhabit that body.

Sample Names

Asha, Blue-17, Celita, Daniv, Emene-3, Era- 4, Flick, Garro, Historia-6, Hope-1, Iseph, Melody, Naga, Olas, Omen, Prime, Ruby-17, Stringer, Twenty Six, Urdun, Verity-3, Yose

Beliefs

Androids hold a variety of religious and philosophical views, with individuals sometimes collecting beliefs and practices through decades of lived experiences. With a similar perspective to elves and other long-lived species, androids tend to view reality differently than beings with shorter lifespans. Many androids are patient in achieving their goals and might create plans that span decades or centuries, hoping they will be alive to experience the results. Elder androids who voluntarily pass on to the next part of their cycle sometimes bequeath their goals to the next soul to inhabit their body.

Popular Edicts

discover your origins, help others achieve long-term goals, plan for the future

Popular Anathema

engage in reckless or self-destructive behavior

Android Mechanics

Hit Points 8

Size Medium

Speed 25 Feet

Attribute Boosts Dexterity, Intelligence, Free

Attribute Flaw Charisma

Languages Common

Additional languages equal to 1 + your Intelligence modifier (if it's positive). Choose from the list of common languages and any other languages to which you have access (such as the languages prevalent on your home world).

Traits

  • android

  • humanoid

Senses Low-Light Vision

previousChinese:
人类的雄心在群星之间建立了诸多帝国。协约世界居住着许多人类，而阿兹兰特星际帝国的扩张则展现出人类势力增长更为阴暗的一面。虽然阿兹兰特星际帝国被视为压迫的堡垒，但人类也在星系各地建立了无数多元包容的社会。人类还参与创建了已知宇宙中最著名的港口：艾巴萨罗姆空间站。无论动机如何，人类都能在连绵的城市和最偏远的星系边疆兴盛发展。

如果你想扮演适应力强、几乎能成为任何角色的人物，就选择人类。

你可能……

  • 为了个人利益或某项事业，努力成就伟业。
  • 渴望探索与体验宇宙。
  • 珍视与家人和朋友的关系。

他人可能……

  • 尊重你的灵活性和通常开放的心态。
  • 怀疑你的动机，担心你只追求权力或财富。
  • 不确定你会有怎样的表现，不愿贸然推断你的意图。

外貌描述

人类的身体特征随血统和家园世界而异，肤色、发色、体型和面部特征多种多样。有些环境会造就独特的人类外貌，例如生活在阿基顿、拥有深红皮肤的希尔基人。许多人类喜欢通过染发、纹身、在皮肤上留下疤痕、以身体艺术和华丽衣饰装点自己，以及安装殖装来改变外貌。

社会

人类社会就像他们生活的世界一样多姿多彩。阿兹兰特星际帝国试图将失落的格拉利昂上的某种古老文化孤立并理想化，以重现想象中的光辉年代；大多数人类群体则在多元社区中与其他物种共存。相距仅数里的人类聚居地，也可能有截然不同的政体与社会规范。尽管生活方式和观点各异，人类普遍适应力强、雄心勃勃——这些特质驱使他们探索未知、开创未来，在无数行星上定居。他们融入异星社会，或在遥远世界建立社区和聚居地，为自己创造生活。

在协约世界的所有常见族裔中，人类或许受到大断层的冲击最为严重。格拉利昂消失后，人类只剩下相对稀少的证据，用以推敲并重建自己的社会。虽然艾巴萨罗姆空间站和其他拥有大量人类居民的世界留存着有关人类古代历史的文献，但这些历史应当与现代人类社会有多大关联，始终是激烈争论的话题。

示例姓名

Akif, Alezandaru, Amare, Baolo, Belor, Darilian, Hadzi, Hai Minh, Hiriko, Iolana, Jokug, Korva, Morvius, Navasi, Pao, Pasara, Raziya, Revhi, Sahba, Seoni, Sephia, Signe, Valeros, Valki, Yon, Zemir

信仰

Chinese:
人类的雄心在群星之间建立了诸多帝国。协约世界居住着许多人类，而阿兹兰特星际帝国的扩张则展现出人类势力增长更为阴暗的一面。虽然阿兹兰特星际帝国被视为压迫的堡垒，但人类也在星系各地建立了无数多元包容的社会。人类还参与创建了已知宇宙中最著名的港口：艾巴萨罗姆空间站。无论动机如何，人类都能在连绵的城市和最偏远的星系边疆兴盛发展。

如果你想扮演适应力强、几乎能成为任何角色的人物，就选择人类。

你可能……

  • 为了个人利益或某项事业，努力成就伟业。
  • 渴望探索与体验宇宙。
  • 珍视与家人和朋友的关系。

他人可能……

  • 尊重你的灵活性和通常开放的心态。
  • 怀疑你的动机，担心你只追求权力或财富。
  • 不确定你会有怎样的表现，不愿贸然推断你的意图。

外貌描述

人类的身体特征随血统和家园世界而异，肤色、发色、体型和面部特征多种多样。有些环境会造就独特的人类外貌，例如生活在阿基顿、拥有深红皮肤的希尔基人。许多人类喜欢通过染发、纹身、在皮肤上留下疤痕、以身体艺术和华丽衣饰装点自己，以及安装殖装来改变外貌。

社会

人类社会就像他们生活的世界一样多姿多彩。阿兹兰特星际帝国试图将失落的格拉利昂上的某种古老文化孤立并理想化，以重现想象中的光辉年代；大多数人类群体则在多元社区中与其他物种共存。相距仅数里的人类聚居地，也可能有截然不同的政体与社会规范。尽管生活方式和观点各异，人类普遍适应力强、雄心勃勃——这些特质驱使他们探索未知、开创未来，在无数行星上定居。他们融入异星社会，或在遥远世界建立社区和聚居地，为自己创造生活。

在协约世界的所有常见族裔中，人类或许受到大断层的冲击最为严重。格拉利昂消失后，人类只剩下相对稀少的证据，用以推敲并重建自己的社会。虽然艾巴萨罗姆空间站和其他拥有大量人类居民的世界留存着有关人类古代历史的文献，但这些历史应当与现代人类社会有多大关联，始终是激烈争论的话题。

模组原文:
Human ambition has created empires throughout the stars. The Pact Worlds have many human residents, while the expansion of the Azlanti Star Empire presents a more sinister expression of humanity's growth. Though the Azlanti Star Empire is considered a bastion of oppression, there are countless diverse and inclusive societies established by humanity across the galaxy. Humans played a role in founding the most famous port in the known cosmos: Absalom Station. Regardless of their motives, humans thrive in both urban sprawls and in the most remote galactic frontiers.

If you want an adaptable character who can become just about anything, you should play a human.

You Might...

  • Strive to achieve greatness, either for personal gain or on behalf of a cause.
  • Yearn to explore and experience the cosmos.
  • Cherish your relationships with family and friends.

Others Probably...

  • Respect your flexibility and usual open-mindedness.
  • Distrust your motivations, fearing you seek only power or wealth.
  • Aren't sure what to expect from you and are hesitant to assume your intentions.

Physical Description

Humans' physical characteristics vary based on their lineage and home world. Humans have a wide variety of skin and hair colors, body types, and facial features. Some environments produce distinct human appearances, such as crimson-skinned hylki humans living on Akiton. Many humans enjoy altering their appearances by dyeing their hair, tattooing or scarring their skin, adorning themselves with body art and decorative garments, and installing augmentations.

Society

Human societies are as varied as the worlds they thrive on. While the Azlanti Star Empire seeks to recapture an imagined era of glory by isolating and idealizing an ancient culture from lost Golarion, most human groups coexist with other species in diverse communities. Human settlements just a few miles apart might have wildly different governmental styles and social norms. Despite their diverse lifestyles and outlooks, humans are adaptive and ambitious—traits that have driven them to explore the unknown, forge their own futures, and settle on countless planets, creating lives for themselves by either integrating into alien societies or creating communities and settlements on distant worlds.

Of all the common ancestries in the Pact Worlds, humans were perhaps the hardest hit by the Gap. Due to Golarion's disappearance, humans were left with relatively little evidence with which to puzzle out and reconstruct their society. While Absalom Station and other worlds with large human populations contain documents related to the ancient history of humanity, how much relevance this should have to modern human society is a hotly debated topic.

Sample Names

Akif, Alezandaru, Amare, Baolo, Belor, Darilian, Hadzi, Hai Minh, Hiriko, Iolana, Jokug, Korva, Morvius, Navasi, Pao, Pasara, Raziya, Revhi, Sahba, Seoni, Sephia, Signe, Valeros, Valki, Yon, Zemir

Beliefs

Humans often believe in the structures they've established, and many adhere to the ideals of the Pact or follow the laws of other regions or organizations, like the Azlanti Star Empire or the Free Captains. Many also cleave tightly to faith, philosophy, or religion, finding in these intellectual and spiritual touchstones confidence, clarity, and comfort. Since humanity eagerly embraces change, there are always humans who oppose societal norms by challenging long-standing beliefs or laws. These ideals, whether societal, intellectual, or spiritual, are often used as a driving force or justification for a human's behavior and ambitions.

Popular Edicts

devote yourself to a greater cause, explore the cosmos, strive for greatness

Popular Anathema

waste what little time you have

Speed 25 Feet

Attribute Boosts Two free attribute, boosts

Additional languages equal to 1 + your Intelligence modifier (if it's positive). Choose from the list of common languages and any other languages to which you have access (such as the languages prevalent in your home world).

趴爪族在名为普洛尼斯的低重力丛林世界进化而来，为摆脱维斯卡里姆征服者的统治，进行了一场漫长的独立战争。最近，趴爪族自由战士击败最后的维斯卡里姆占领军，随后投票决定以主权行星的身份加入协约世界。如今，普洛尼斯仍是草木苍翠的繁茂世界，却饱受危险的磁暴侵袭，并留下维斯卡里姆残酷入侵造成的伤痕。求生的斗争影响了许多趴爪族传统，形成了竞技战争游戏、古老神秘主义和非常规科技并存的文化。从大众娱乐到传统战术，音乐伴随趴爪族文化中的一切活动，甚至武术战斗也被归类为一种战舞。

如果你想扮演以优雅与风采为自由而战的角色，就选择趴爪族。

你可能……

  • 享受友好的竞争。
  • 是才华横溢的表演者，或熟悉多种音乐和舞蹈流派的鉴赏家。
  • 坚守先祖传统，拒绝向残暴的专制者屈膝。

他人可能……

  • 认为你不擅长使用计算机、载具和其他科技。
  • 羡慕你的音乐天赋。
  • 认为你在找借口通过战斗证明自己。

外貌描述

趴爪族是全身覆有毛皮的猫形类人生物。毛色包括黑色、白色、蓝色、三花、双色及虎斑，常有不规则形状组成的独特纹样，传统上预言者会据此占卜个体的潜力。他们的眼睛可以呈现可见光谱中的任何颜色。典型趴爪族身高6至7尺，四肢修长、关节灵活。他们的生理结构高度可变，离开普洛尼斯的家庭经常发现，孩子在适应更强重力的过程中，身体变得更加粗壮，肌肉也更加发达。

趴爪族有锋利的牙齿，手脚长着可以收回的爪子。口鼻部遍布一组独特的感觉器官，其功能因人而异。这些周围神经中最常见的包括能够感受声音的谐波感官。

社会

趴爪族文化深受传统影响，竞争激烈。个体争夺认可与资源，仿佛重演家园星球严酷的自然秩序。在维斯卡里姆入侵之前，普洛尼斯难以预测的磁暴就已使科技进步陷入停滞。即使到了今天，普洛尼斯的科技发展仍集中在陶瓷、生物工程、化学与魔法。脱离维斯卡里姆后，普洛尼斯各民族国家的居民以压倒性票数赞成加入协约世界，如今仍在适应这一新的政治归属。

多数趴爪族是无性恋者。大多数人寻求与伴侣建立充满爱意、终生相守的关系，但现代很少有人决定生育。趴爪族每胎生育6至8名孩子，偏好共同育儿，让父母能够保持各自的个性，并共同承担责任。

示例姓名

传统趴爪族名字包含由秘术师确定的吉祥元素。名字示例包括Cahnex、Dae、Fetenekku、Hafoumei、Ifset、Ihrasara、Jeviish、Khieper、Lealorn、Mahdran、Miiyu、Onharaf、Rishir、Sanna、Tendris、Teoshanhi、Vokuvi、Voyenrel和Zamahaii。

信仰

经历维斯卡里姆数代压迫后，许多趴爪族紧紧守护普洛尼斯先祖传统，努力延续自己的文化。普洛尼斯文化重视个人成功和在同辈中脱颖而出，将一切存在视为一首宏大的乐曲：每个人、事件与行动，都为那自时间开端奏响的星系交响乐增添旋律。大多数趴爪族享受健康且富有成效的竞争，相信真正的潜能唯有在斗争中才能展现。暗中破坏或公然不尊重遵守竞赛规则的对手，是严重的冒犯，通常也被视为软弱的表现。当面对不讲荣誉的敌人，例如科技先进的维斯卡里姆入侵者时，趴爪族会为这套准则破例。此时，任何形式的抵抗都可以接受，“下作”的战术被视为应对敌人不公平优势的明智手段。许多信奉宗教的趴爪族向梅耶尔祈祷，这位掌管舞蹈、音乐与战斗的先祖神祇在普洛尼斯受到崇拜。

常见典范

挑战自己与盟友，每天演奏音乐与跳舞，为自己的成就自豪

常见禁忌

放弃先祖传统，向暴君屈服，放弃自己的身份

趴爪族在名为普洛尼斯的低重力丛林世界进化而来，为摆脱维斯卡里姆征服者的统治，进行了一场漫长的独立战争。最近，趴爪族自由战士击败最后的维斯卡里姆占领军，随后投票决定以主权行星的身份加入协约世界。如今，普洛尼斯仍是草木苍翠的繁茂世界，却饱受危险的磁暴侵袭，并留下维斯卡里姆残酷入侵造成的伤痕。求生的斗争影响了许多趴爪族传统，形成了竞技战争游戏、古老神秘主义和非常规科技并存的文化。从大众娱乐到传统战术，音乐伴随趴爪族文化中的一切活动，甚至武术战斗也被归类为一种战舞。

如果你想扮演以优雅与风采为自由而战的角色，就选择趴爪族。

你可能……

  • 享受友好的竞争。
  • 是才华横溢的表演者，或熟悉多种音乐和舞蹈流派的鉴赏家。
  • 坚守先祖传统，拒绝向残暴的专制者屈膝。

他人可能……

  • 认为你不擅长使用计算机、载具和其他科技。
  • 羡慕你的音乐天赋。
  • 认为你在找借口通过战斗证明自己。

外貌描述

趴爪族是全身覆有毛皮的猫形类人生物。毛色包括黑色、白色、蓝色、三花、双色及虎斑，常有不规则形状组成的独特纹样，传统上预言者会据此占卜个体的潜力。他们的眼睛可以呈现可见光谱中的任何颜色。典型趴爪族身高6至7尺，四肢修长、关节灵活。他们的生理结构高度可变，离开普洛尼斯的家庭经常发现，孩子在适应更强重力的过程中，身体变得更加粗壮，肌肉也更加发达。

趴爪族有锋利的牙齿，手脚长着可以收回的爪子。口鼻部遍布一组独特的感觉器官，其功能因人而异。这些周围神经中最常见的包括能够感受声音的谐波感官。

社会

趴爪族文化深受传统影响，竞争激烈。个体争夺认可与资源，仿佛重演家园星球严酷的自然秩序。在维斯卡里姆入侵之前，普洛尼斯难以预测的磁暴就已使科技进步陷入停滞。即使到了今天，普洛尼斯的科技发展仍集中在陶瓷、生物工程、化学与魔法。脱离维斯卡里姆后，普洛尼斯各民族国家的居民以压倒性票数赞成加入协约世界，如今仍在适应这一新的政治归属。

多数趴爪族是无性恋者。大多数人寻求与伴侣建立充满爱意、终生相守的关系，但现代很少有人决定生育。趴爪族每胎生育6至8名孩子，偏好共同育儿，让父母能够保持各自的个性，并共同承担责任。

示例姓名

传统趴爪族名字包含由秘术师确定的吉祥元素。名字示例包括Cahnex、戴伊（Dae）、Fetenekku、Hafoumei、Ifset、Ihrasara、Jeviish、Khieper、Lealorn、Mahdran、Miiyu、Onharaf、Rishir、Sanna、Tendris、Teoshanhi、Vokuvi、Voyenrel和Zamahaii。

信仰

经历维斯卡里姆数代压迫后，许多趴爪族紧紧守护普洛尼斯先祖传统，努力延续自己的文化。普洛尼斯文化重视个人成功和在同辈中脱颖而出，将一切存在视为一首宏大的乐曲：每个人、事件与行动，都为那自时间开端奏响的星系交响乐增添旋律。大多数趴爪族享受健康且富有成效的竞争，相信真正的潜能唯有在斗争中才能展现。暗中破坏或公然不尊重遵守竞赛规则的对手，是严重的冒犯，通常也被视为软弱的表现。当面对不讲荣誉的敌人，例如科技先进的维斯卡里姆入侵者时，趴爪族会为这套准则破例。此时，任何形式的抵抗都可以接受，“下作”的战术被视为应对敌人不公平优势的明智手段。许多信奉宗教的趴爪族向梅耶尔祈祷，这位掌管舞蹈、音乐与战斗的先祖神祇在普洛尼斯受到崇拜。

常见典范

挑战自己与盟友，每天演奏音乐与跳舞，为自己的成就自豪

常见禁忌

放弃先祖传统，向暴君屈服，放弃自己的身份

模组原文:
Pahtras evolved on a low-gravity jungle world called Pulonis, where they fought a long war for independence from their Veskarium conquerors. Recently, pahtra freedom fighters defeated the last Veskarium occupiers, then voted to join the Pact Worlds as a sovereign planet. Today, Pulonis is a lush, verdant world wracked by dangerous magnetic storms and scarred by the Veskarium's brutal invasion. The struggles of survival have influenced many pahtra traditions, leading to a culture of competitive war games, time-honored mysticism, and unorthodox technology. Music accompanies everything in pahtra culture, from popular entertainment to traditional battle tactics, with martial combat even categorized as a form of battle dance.

If you want to play a character who fights for freedom with grace and style, you should play a pahtra.

You Might...

  • Enjoy friendly competition.
  • Be a talented performer or cultured aficionado of a wide variety of music and dance genres.
  • Hold true to your ancestral traditions and refuse to kneel to cruel despots.

Others Probably...

  • Think you struggle with computers, vehicles, and other technology.
  • Envy your musical talent.
  • Assume you're looking for an excuse to prove yourself in a fight.

Physical Description

Pahtras are feline humanoids covered in fur. Their coats vary from black, white, blue, calico, bi-colored, and tabby, often possessing unique patterns of irregular shapes that seers traditionally use to divine an individual's potential. Their eyes vary across all colors of the visible spectrum. Typical pahtras stand between 6 and 7 feet tall, with elongated limbs and flexible joints. Their physiology is highly mutable, and families that leave Pulonis often find their children developing stockier and more muscular bodies as they adjust to higher gravity.

Pahtras have sharp teeth and retractable claws on their hands and feet. They have a unique set of sensory organs across their muzzles, with functions varying from individual to individual. The most common of these peripheral nerves include harmonic sensory apparatuses that can feel sound.

Society

Pahtra cultures are steeped in tradition and highly competitive, with individuals vying for recognition and resources in a struggle that mimics the harsh natural order of their planet. Before the Veskarium invasion, technological advancement on Pulonis stalled because of the world's unpredictable magnetic storms. Even today, Pulonian technological development focuses on ceramics, bioengineering, chemistry, and magic. After breaking from the Veskarium, residents of Pulonis's nation-states overwhelmingly voted to join the Pact Worlds, and they're still acclimating to this new political allegiance.

The majority of pahtras are asexual. Most seek loving and life-long relationships with partners, but in modern times few commit to having children. Pahtras bear litters of six to eight children and prefer communal child-rearing, which allows parents to retain their individuality and shoulder responsibilities together.

Sample Names

Traditional pahtra names contain auspicious elements determined by a mystic. Pahtra names include Cahnex, Dae, Fetenekku, Hafoumei, Ifset, Ihrasara, Jeviish, Khieper, Lealorn, Mahdran, Miiyu, Onharaf, Rishir, Sanna, Tendris, Teoshanhi, Vokuvi, Voyenrel, and Zamahaii.

Beliefs

Many pahtras cling fiercely to their ancestral Pulonian traditions in an effort to keep their cultures alive after enduring generations of oppression by the Veskarium. Pulonian culture values personal success and standing out from one's peers and views all existence as a great song, with each person, event, and action adding to the galactic symphony that began at the dawn of time. Most pahtras enjoy healthy and productive competition, believing that one's true potential can emerge only from struggle. Underhandedly sabotaging or blatantly disrespecting a rival who follows the rules of a competition is a grave offense and usually seen as a sign of weakness. Pahtras make an exception to this code when facing a dishonorable foe, such as invaders from the technologically advanced Veskarium. In such cases, any form of resistance is acceptable, and the use of “dirty” tactics is considered a wise counter to a foe's unfair advantages. Many religious pahtras pray to Meyel, an ancestral deity of dance, music, and battle worshipped on Pulonis.

Popular Edicts

challenge yourself and your allies, perform music and dance daily, take pride in your accomplishments

Popular Anathema

abandon your ancestral traditions, bow to tyrants, give up your identity

Speed 25 Feet

Attribute Flaw Constitution

Languages Common, Pahtra, Vesk

  • pahtra

希伦虫人最初是虫群的成员；虫群由受蜂巢思维控制的许多虫族群落组成，能吞噬整颗行星。后来，希伦虫人产生了个体的自我意识，拒绝虫群盲目的吞噬行为。他们逃离蜂巢思维，在协约世界定居，建立自己的社区，也融入已有的聚居地。

如果你想扮演乐于团队协作、同时珍视独立的角色，就选择希伦虫人。

你可能……

  • 与同伴建立深厚而强大的纽带。
  • 享受自由，为能够自己做决定而欣喜。
  • 不喜欢暴力，宁愿寻求让所有人获益的和平妥协。

他人可能……

  • 指望你调解争端，担当理性的声音。
  • 认为你过于看重简单的选择，并为此思虑过多。
  • 对你昆虫般的生理结构和心灵感应能力感到不安。

外貌描述

希伦虫人是拥有触角、复眼和几丁质外骨骼的节肢动物。他们直立行走，拥有三对肢体，手上长有三只爪。位置较低、较为纤弱的肢体通常隐藏起来，只在仪式和繁衍时使用。希伦虫人的外貌随祖先所属群落而异，有些拥有退化的翅膀、分节的胸部或螫针。

希伦虫人有三种承担不同繁殖职责的性别：雄体、雌体和育体。雌体与雄体分别提供卵子和精子，育体孵化受精卵。有些希伦虫人社区由一个育体为多名伴侣孵化后代，其他社区则普遍采用三方结合。希伦虫人最初两年处于蠕虫般的幼虫形态。家长可能将幼虫孩子带在保护容器中，让他们安全体验世界，直至进入蛹期。蛹在约八岁时经历第二次变态，数年后才最终形成成熟的身体。

社会

希伦虫人重视个体的选择与权利。他们得以逃离虫群，正是因为身体发生适应性变化，在为自己做出选择时会产生愉悦。希伦虫人文化建立在这种对选择的热爱之上，鼓励族人接纳各种信仰、哲学与职业。希伦虫人的群居性很强，不属于某个团体便容易感到孤独。选定社区之后，他们往往承担特定的专职角色。在艰难时刻，只要仍能保持自主权，他们就会积极协作，将集体的最大利益置于仅惠及个人的利益之上。

示例姓名

希伦虫人主要通过心灵感应交流，拥有一个完全由思想构成的秘密“魂名”。他们乐于接受同伴给予的绰号。一些有声名字包括Cesca、Chk Chk、Halicon、Izenzi、Jchk、J'scib、Keskodai、Kinnik、Korskal、Philt、Schect、Thast、T'sen、Xylit、Zenka和Zigvigix。

信仰

希伦虫人以自己的选择定义自我，对一切形式的压迫充满抗拒。他们享受文化交流，大多数热切接受其他社区的神祇与习俗，也有人坚持热忱的无神论世界观，摒弃神明崇拜，将世俗凡人的经历置于中心。许多希伦虫人社区敬奉海拉丝，这位仁慈的神祇被认为是他们物种的始祖。海拉丝的信仰也反过来受到希伦信徒塑造，他们认为祂是团结而不盲从的极致体现。

常见典范

自己做出选择，努力和平解决问题，为集体的更大利益努力

常见禁忌

造成不经思考的破坏，剥夺他人做出选择的权利

Chinese:
希伦虫人最初是虫群的成员；虫群由受蜂巢思维控制的许多虫族群落组成，能吞噬整颗行星。后来，希伦虫人产生了个体的自我意识，拒绝虫群盲目的吞噬行为。他们逃离蜂巢思维，在协约世界定居，建立自己的社区，也融入已有的聚居地。

如果你想扮演乐于团队协作、同时珍视独立的角色，就选择希伦虫人。

你可能……

  • 与同伴建立深厚而强大的纽带。
  • 享受自由，为能够自己做决定而欣喜。
  • 不喜欢暴力，宁愿寻求让所有人获益的和平妥协。

他人可能……

  • 指望你调解争端，担当理性的声音。
  • 认为你过于看重简单的选择，并为此思虑过多。
  • 对你昆虫般的生理结构和心灵感应能力感到不安。

外貌描述

希伦虫人是拥有触角、复眼和几丁质外骨骼的节肢动物。他们直立行走，拥有三对肢体，手上长有三只爪。位置较低、较为纤弱的肢体通常隐藏起来，只在仪式和繁衍时使用。希伦虫人的外貌随祖先所属群落而异，有些拥有退化的翅膀、分节的胸部或螫针。

希伦虫人有三种承担不同繁殖职责的性别：雄体、雌体和育体。雌体与雄体分别提供卵子和精子，育体孵化受精卵。有些希伦虫人社区由一个育体为多名伴侣孵化后代，其他社区则普遍采用三方结合。希伦虫人最初两年处于蠕虫般的幼虫形态。家长可能将幼虫孩子带在保护容器中，让他们安全体验世界，直至进入蛹期。蛹在约八岁时经历第二次变态，数年后才最终形成成熟的身体。

社会

希伦虫人重视个体的选择与权利。他们得以逃离虫群，正是因为身体发生适应性变化，在为自己做出选择时会产生愉悦。希伦虫人文化建立在这种对选择的热爱之上，鼓励族人接纳各种信仰、哲学与职业。希伦虫人的群居性很强，不属于某个团体便容易感到孤独。选定社区之后，他们往往承担特定的专职角色。在艰难时刻，只要仍能保持自主权，他们就会积极协作，将集体的最大利益置于仅惠及个人的利益之上。

示例姓名

希伦虫人主要通过心灵感应交流，拥有一个完全由思想构成的秘密“魂名”。他们乐于接受同伴给予的绰号。一些有声名字包括Cesca、齐克齐克（Chk Chk）、Halicon、Izenzi、Jchk、J'scib、Keskodai、Kinnik、Korskal、Philt、Schect、Thast、T'sen、Xylit、Zenka和Zigvigix。

信仰

希伦虫人以自己的选择定义自我，对一切形式的压迫充满抗拒。他们享受文化交流，大多数热切接受其他社区的神祇与习俗，也有人坚持热忱的无神论世界观，摒弃神明崇拜，将世俗凡人的经历置于中心。许多希伦虫人社区敬奉海拉丝，这位仁慈的神祇被认为是他们物种的始祖。海拉丝的信仰也反过来受到希伦信徒塑造，他们认为祂是团结而不盲从的极致体现。

常见典范

自己做出选择，努力和平解决问题，为集体的更大利益努力

常见禁忌

造成不经思考的破坏，剥夺他人做出选择的权利

模组原文:
Shirrens were originally members of the Swarm, a collection of colonies controlled by a hive mind that devoured entire planets. In time, shirrens gained a sense of individual self and rejected the Swarm's mindless consumption. They fled the hive mind and settled in the Pact Worlds, where they established their own communities and integrated into existing settlements.

If you want a character who enjoys working as part of a team while still valuing independence, you should play a shirren.

You Might...

  • Build deep and powerful bonds with your comrades.
  • Enjoy your freedom and delight in the opportunity to make your own decisions.
  • Dislike violence and prefer seeking peaceful compromises that benefit everyone.

Others Probably...

  • Count on you to mediate disputes and act as a voice of reason.
  • Believe you overvalue and overthink simple choices.
  • Are disconcerted by your insectile physiology and telepathy.

Physical Description

Shirrens are arthropods with antennae, compound eyes, and chitinous exoskeletons. Shirrens walk upright and have three sets of limbs with three-clawed hands. The lower, weaker pairs of limbs are generally kept concealed and only used for ceremonial and reproductive reasons. Shirrens vary in appearance based on the colony they descended from, and some have vestigial wings, segmented thoraxes, or stingers.

Shirrens have three sexes with roles in reproduction: male, female, and host. Female and male shirrens provide eggs and sperm respectively, and hosts incubate the fertilized eggs. In some shirren communities, a single host incubates for many partners, while three-party unions are common in others. Shirren young spend their first 2 years in a wormlike larval form. A parent might carry their larval child in a protective container to let them safely experience the world until they reach the pupal stage. Pupae undergo a second metamorphosis around eight years old before settling into their mature form a few years later.

Society

Shirrens value individual choice and rights, having escaped from the Swarm thanks to an adaptation to their physiology that causes pleasure when they make choices for themselves. Shirren culture is built around this love of choice, encouraging shirrens to adapt themselves to a wide variety of beliefs, philosophies, and professions. Shirrens are highly communal and tend to feel lonely unless they're part of a group. Once a shirren chooses a community for themself, they often settle into a specialized role. When times are tough, they pitch in for teamwork and prioritize what's best for the group over what only benefits them as individuals, as long as they retain their autonomy.

Sample Names

Shirrens rely primarily on telepathy for communication and have a secret “soul-name” that's purely thought-based. Shirrens readily accept nicknames bestowed by their companions. Some shirren speech-names include Cesca, Chk Chk, Halicon, Izenzi, Jchk, J'scib, Keskodai, Kinnik, Korskal, Philt, Schect, Thast, T'sen, Xylit, Zenka, and Zigvigix.

Beliefs

Shirrens define themselves by their choices and bristle against all forms of oppression. They enjoy cultural exchange, and while most eagerly adopt the deities and practices of other communities, others hold passionately atheistic worldviews that reject divine worship in favor of centering secular mortal experiences. Many shirren communities pay homage to Hylax, a benevolent deity believed to be the progenitor of their species. Hylax's faith is in turn shaped by her shirren followers, who believe her to be the pinnacle of unity without conformity.

Popular Edicts

make your own choices, try to solve problems peacefully, work for the greater good of the group

Popular Anathema

inflict thoughtless destruction, take away another's right to make choices
