维斯克蜥人有着漫长的冲突历史，最初在自身星系内征服诸世界，后来又与协约世界、虫群等邻近星际势力交战。如今，维斯卡里姆正与阿兹兰特星际帝国交战。冲突渗透了维斯克文化的大多数方面，催生出强大的军国主义帝国，以血腥方式崇拜其战神戴莫力图斯。残酷的历史与军国主义价值观塑造着维斯克蜥人，他们常常拥抱冲突，重视力量、职责与个人荣誉准则。个体也同样可能将这些文化价值运用于战斗之外的生活，尤其是商业与体育；有些则彻底抛弃或反对家园世界统治者强加的无情价值观。每名维斯克蜥人都可以自行决定，成为征服者、合作者，或完全不同的存在。

如果你想扮演忠于职责、勇敢而坚忍的角色，就选择维斯克蜥人。

你可能……

  • 珍惜与值得一战的对手交锋、证明自己的机会。

  • 具有强烈的责任感与荣誉感。

  • 私下流露温柔或爆发情绪，令同伴惊讶。

他人可能……

  • 敬畏你残酷的名声，却也庆幸拥有你这样强大的盟友。

  • 将你的坚忍误认为无情。

  • 害怕在战场上与你为敌。

外貌描述

维斯克蜥人身高可达7尺，通常肌肉发达，全身覆有坚韧的鳞状皮肤。尖角从头骨长出，沿下颚形成骨质“胡须”，有时还沿脊柱延伸至强壮的尾部。鳞片通常呈不同深浅的绿色，也可能带有鲜艳的斑驳色彩，有时被视为健康与魅力的象征。

维斯克蜥人在历史早期就采用了科技武器，却仍保有天生掠食者凶猛的爪牙。他们精心护理并涂绘鳞片与利爪，展示个人风格，威慑他人。

社会

维斯克社会组织严密，崇尚军事。维斯克蜥人最初居住在一颗行星上，很快便扩张至同一星系的其他世界。如今，这些被征服的世界统称维斯卡里姆，每颗星球以数字标明与恒星的距离及被征服的次序，例如维斯克三号或八号。族裔故乡维斯克主星是维斯卡里姆政府所在地，也是维斯克文化的核心。

维斯克蜥人的名字通常结合父母及其他杰出祖先名字中的元素。同伴经常在日常交往中使用简称，但未经允许这么做是严重的侮辱。有些维斯克蜥人采用象征战斗胜利的称号，例如“三把枪”“虚空行者”或“吞队者”。

示例姓名

Abazobari, Ahadigar, Asthonad, Dotralan, Evdokayo, Julukesh, Katara, Obozaya, Oromeras, Radokama, Sarangari, Sobok, Terikoraz, Vindasorn, Yuluzak

信仰

维斯卡里姆的大多数维斯克蜥人敬奉职责与战争之神——征服者戴莫力图斯，以及祂麾下的战圣军。战圣生前是体现维斯克文化价值的凡人典范，获得戴莫力图斯赐福后取得神性；如今，他们与神祇一同受到崇拜。典型的维斯克蜥人以个人荣誉和力量的理想应对人生中的所有斗争，也明白并非所有冲突都发生在战场上。许多人从严格的法律体系中获得慰藉，也有人将个人道德感置于一切之上；无论哪一种，大多数维斯克蜥人都会毫不犹豫地为自己认为正确的事而战。即使战斗时，大多数维斯克蜥人也以准则约束行为。维斯卡里姆内部的冲突往往既暴烈又严守纪律，甚至迁就对手，以便双方都遵循规定的战争秩序。典型的维斯克蜥人始终尊重对手，摒弃处决俘虏或伤害平民之类怯懦的战术。

常见典范

光荣地战斗，克制私下的情绪，绝不向敌人示弱

常见禁忌

背叛盟友，放弃战斗

Chinese:
维斯克蜥人有着漫长的冲突历史，最初在自身星系内征服诸世界，后来又与协约世界、虫群等邻近星际势力交战。如今，维斯卡里姆正与阿兹兰特星际帝国交战。冲突渗透了维斯克文化的大多数方面，催生出强大的军国主义帝国，以血腥方式崇拜其战神戴莫力图斯。残酷的历史与军国主义价值观塑造着维斯克蜥人，他们常常拥抱冲突，重视力量、职责与个人荣誉准则。个体也同样可能将这些文化价值运用于战斗之外的生活，尤其是商业与体育；有些则彻底抛弃或反对家园世界统治者强加的无情价值观。每名维斯克蜥人都可以自行决定，成为征服者、合作者，或完全不同的存在。

如果你想扮演忠于职责、勇敢而坚忍的角色，就选择维斯克蜥人。

你可能……

  • 珍惜与值得一战的对手交锋、证明自己的机会。

  • 具有强烈的责任感与荣誉感。

  • 私下流露温柔或爆发情绪，令同伴惊讶。

他人可能……

  • 敬畏你残酷的名声，却也庆幸拥有你这样强大的盟友。

  • 将你的坚忍误认为无情。

  • 害怕在战场上与你为敌。

外貌描述

维斯克蜥人身高可达7尺，通常肌肉发达，全身覆有坚韧的鳞状皮肤。尖角从头骨长出，沿下颚形成骨质“胡须”，有时还沿脊柱延伸至强壮的尾部。鳞片通常呈不同深浅的绿色，也可能带有鲜艳的斑驳色彩，有时被视为健康与魅力的象征。

维斯克蜥人在历史早期就采用了科技武器，却仍保有天生掠食者凶猛的爪牙。他们精心护理并涂绘鳞片与利爪，展示个人风格，威慑他人。

社会

维斯克社会组织严密，崇尚军事。维斯克蜥人最初居住在一颗行星上，很快便扩张至同一星系的其他世界。如今，这些被征服的世界统称维斯卡里姆，每颗星球以数字标明与恒星的距离及被征服的次序，例如维斯克三号或八号。族裔故乡维斯克主星是维斯卡里姆政府所在地，也是维斯克文化的核心。

维斯克蜥人的名字通常结合父母及其他杰出祖先名字中的元素。同伴经常在日常交往中使用简称，但未经允许这么做是严重的侮辱。有些维斯克蜥人采用象征战斗胜利的称号，例如“三把枪”“虚空行者”或“吞队者”。

示例姓名

Abazobari, Ahadigar, Asthonad, Dotralan, Evdokayo, Julukesh, Katara, 奥波扎雅（Obozaya）, Oromeras, Radokama, Sarangari, Sobok, Terikoraz, Vindasorn, Yuluzak

信仰

维斯卡里姆的大多数维斯克蜥人敬奉职责与战争之神——征服者戴莫力图斯，以及祂麾下的战圣军。战圣生前是体现维斯克文化价值的凡人典范，获得戴莫力图斯赐福后取得神性；如今，他们与神祇一同受到崇拜。典型的维斯克蜥人以个人荣誉和力量的理想应对人生中的所有斗争，也明白并非所有冲突都发生在战场上。许多人从严格的法律体系中获得慰藉，也有人将个人道德感置于一切之上；无论哪一种，大多数维斯克蜥人都会毫不犹豫地为自己认为正确的事而战。即使战斗时，大多数维斯克蜥人也以准则约束行为。维斯卡里姆内部的冲突往往既暴烈又严守纪律，甚至迁就对手，以便双方都遵循规定的战争秩序。典型的维斯克蜥人始终尊重对手，摒弃处决俘虏或伤害平民之类怯懦的战术。

常见典范

光荣地战斗，克制私下的情绪，绝不向敌人示弱

常见禁忌

背叛盟友，放弃战斗

模组原文:
Vesk have a long history of conflict, first as conquerors within their own star system and later clashing with neighboring stellar powers such as the Pact Worlds and the Swarm. Currently, the Veskarium is at war with the Azlanti Star Empire. Conflict permeates most aspects of vesk cultures, creating powerful militaristic empires devoted to the bloody worship of their warrior god Damoritosh. Their brutal history and militaristic values shape vesk, who often embrace conflict and value strength, duty, and a personal code of honor. Individual vesk are just as likely to apply these cultural values to other aspects of life besides battle, notably in business and sport, and some vesk might abandon or oppose the ruthless values enforced by the rulers of their home worlds entirely. It's up to each vesk to claim their role as a conqueror or a collaborator—or something else entirely.

If you want a character who's duty bound, brave, and stoic, you should play a vesk.

You Might...

  • Relish the chance to prove yourself in combat against worthy opponents.

  • Have a strong sense of duty and honor.

  • Surprise your companions with tenderness and emotional outbursts in private.

Others Probably...

  • Respect and fear your brutal reputation but appreciate your strength as an ally.

  • Mistake your stoicism for heartlessness.

  • Fear facing you in battle.

Physical Description

Vesk stand up to 7 feet tall, are generally muscular, and are covered in tough, scaly skin. Spiky horns grow from their skulls and form bony “beards” along their jaws that sometimes extend down their spines to their powerful tails. Vesk scales are generally shades of green but can also display vibrant, mottled coloration that's sometimes considered an indicator of health and attractiveness.

Vesk adopted tech weapons early in their history but retain the brutal claws and teeth of natural predators. They take great care in grooming and painting their scales and claws to showcase their personal style and intimidate others.

Society

Vesk society is highly organized and militaristic. Vesk first dwelled on a single planet but quickly spread to other worlds in their system. Today, the name for these conquered worlds is the Veskarium, with each given a number to mark their distance from the sun and order of conquest (such as Vesk-3 or Vesk-8). Vesk Prime, the vesk ancestral home, is the seat of Veskarium government and the heart of their culture.

Vesk names typically combine elements of their parents' names as well as those of other prominent ancestors. Companions often shorten these names for casual use, but doing so without permission is a grave insult. Some vesk take on epithets that signify their victories in combat, such as “Three Guns,” “Voidwalker,” or “Squadeater.”

Sample Names

Abazobari, Ahadigar, Asthonad, Dotralan, Evdokayo, Julukesh, Katara, Obozaya, Oromeras, Radokama, Sarangari, Sobok, Terikoraz, Vindasorn, Yuluzak

Beliefs

Most vesk in the Veskarium venerate Damoritosh the Conqueror, god of duty and war, and his army of battle saints. In life, the saints were mortal paragons who embodied vesk cultural values and attained divinity after earning Damoritosh's blessing; now they're worshipped alongside their deity. A typical vesk faces all of life's struggles armed with ideals of personal honor and strength, recognizing that not all conflicts occur on the battlefield. Many vesk find comfort in rigid systems of law, while others hold their personal sense of morality above all else—in either case, most vesk don't hesitate to fight for what they believe is right. Even while fighting, most vesk apply a code to their actions, and conflicts within the Veskarium tend to be as disciplined as they are violent, stretching to accommodate opposing sides following the prescribed order of war. A typical vesk always respects their opponent and shuns cowardly tactics, such as executing prisoners or harming civilians.

Popular Edicts

battle honorably, keep private emotions in check, never show weakness to enemies

Popular Anathema

betray an ally, give up the fight

Chinese:

模组原文:
You fill the space around you with divine flames that protect allies within it and burn away those who mean you harm, especially from unholy and technological threats. You and allies in the area are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed}. As the nature of this effect still leaves the target's location obvious, the target can't use this concealment to [[/act hide]] or [[/act sneak]].

Enemies beginning their turn in the area take 10 fire damage, become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.6A2QDy8wRGCVQsSd]{Glitching 1} if they have the tech trait, and become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round if they have the unholy trait.

previousChinese:
一粒质量极其密集的微小粒子在魔法作用下扩展为引力奇点，将生物拉向自身，并在空间上压缩被移入其中的生物。你在一个未被任何生物占据的5尺方格内创造一个奇点。法术施放时，奇点周围@Template[type:emanation|distance:50]内的所有生物和未被固定的物体，根据其反射豁免结果向奇点移动（见下文）。生物和物体从距离奇点最近者开始移动，因此它们可能挡住随后被拉入的其他生物和物体的路径。

生物的空间可以在包含奇点的方格内重叠。进入奇点或在其中结束其回合的生物或物体受到10d10钝击伤害，无法豁免。在奇点内，生物除了对抗你的法术DC尝试@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{脱逃}之外，无法采取任何动作。法术结束时，奇点消失，重叠的生物被移至最近的未占用空间，具体由GM决定。

对于向远离奇点方向移动的生物，弥漫区域内的方格是困难地形；向奇点靠近的生物每花费5尺移动距离，便可移动10尺。

施放法术时位于区域内，以及在区域内结束其回合的生物，需要尝试一次反射豁免。

大成功该生物不受影响。

成功该生物被拉向奇点10尺。

失败该生物被拉向奇点20尺。

大失败该生被拉向奇点30尺。

模组原文:
A tiny particle of incredibly dense mass magically blossoms into a gravitational singularity that pulls creatures toward it and spatially compresses any creatures that are moved into it. You create a singularity in a 5-foot square that is unoccupied by any creatures. All creatures and unsecured objects in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:50] around the singularity are moved toward the singularity when the spell is cast, depending on their Reflex save (see below). Creatures and objects are moved starting with those closest to the singularity, so they might block the path of other creatures and objects that are pulled in later.

Creatures' spaces can overlap in the square that contains the singularity. A creature or object that enters the singularity or ends its turn there takes 10d10 bludgeoning damage with no saving throw. While in the singularity, a creature can take no actions except to attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SkZAQRkLLkmBQNB9]{Escape} against your Spell DC. When the spell ends, the singularity disappears, and overlapping creatures are moved to the closest unoccupied space, as determined by the GM.

Squares in the emanation are difficult terrain for creatures moving away from the singularity, and creatures moving toward the singularity can move 10 feet for each 5 feet of movement they spend.

A creature needs to attempt a Reflex save if it's in the area when the spell is cast and when it ends its turn in the area.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is pulled 10 feet toward the singularity.

Failure The creature is pulled 20 feet toward the singularity.

Critical Failure The creature is pulled 30 feet toward the singularity.

If you instead touch one unoccupied 5-foot square, that surface becomes charged with adhering magic. That space becomes greater difficult terrain.

你用元素能量制造出一件进阶、军用或简易武器，并将其实体化于一名纽带中的生物的手中。为制造的武器选择一个元素特征：气、土、火、金、水或木。该武器是一件战术型装备，并且已经完全充能并装填有基础弹药。它不能由任何特殊材料制成。

该武器有一个次等强化槽位，但可以用你在施放该法术时手中持握的强化模块进行强化，你将强化模块用作法器，这些强化模组在法术结束前变为惰性。武器在造成正常伤害以外，还会额外造成1d4基于所选特征的伤害：气为电击，土为钝击，火为火焰，金为酸蚀，水为寒冷，木为毒素。

升阶（2环）你可以制造先进型武器。

升阶（5环）你可以制造卓越型武器。

升阶（6环）你可以制造精英型武器。

升阶（8环）你可以制造终极型武器。

升阶（9环）你可以制造完美型武器。
Chinese:
你用元素能量制造出一件进阶、军用或简易武器，并将其实体化于一名结绊生物的手中。为制造的武器选择一个元素特征：气、土、火、金、水或木。该武器是一件战术型装备，并且已经完全充能并装填有基础弹药。它不能由任何特殊材料制成。

该武器的强化槽位比通常少一个，但可以用你在施放该法术时手中持握的强化模块进行强化，你将强化模块用作施法载体，这些强化模块在法术结束前变为惰性。武器在造成正常伤害以外，还会额外造成1d4基于所选特征的伤害：气为电击，土为钝击，火为火焰，金为酸蚀，水为寒冷，木为毒素。

升阶（2环）你可以制造先进型武器。

升阶（5环）你可以制造卓越型武器。

升阶（6环）你可以制造菁英型武器。

升阶（8环）你可以制造终极型武器。

升阶（9环）你可以制造完美型武器。
模组原文:
You create an advanced, martial, or simple weapon out of elemental energy that materializes in the hands of a bonded creature. Select an elemental trait for the created weapon: air, earth, fire, metal, water, or wood. The weapon is tactical grade and comes fully charged and loaded with basic ammunition. It cannot be made of any special materials.

The weapon has one fewer upgrade slot but can be upgraded with any upgrades you hold in your hands as a locus when casting this spell, which become inert until the spell ends. The weapon deals damage as normal plus 1d4 additional damage based on the chosen trait: electricity for air, bludgeoning for earth, fire for fire, acid for metal, cold for water, or poison for wood.

Heightened (2nd) You can create an advanced weapon.

Heightened (5th) You can create a superior weapon.

Heightened (6th) You can create an elite weapon.

Heightened (8th) You can create an ultimate weapon.

Heightened (9th) You can create a paragon weapon.

这些宝石是阿兹兰特星际帝国（Azlanti Star Empire）的常见物品，也是冒险者和富裕收藏家青睐的身份象征。尽管外形和功能多种多样，据说这些石头全都是异界存在在远古时代建造物质宇宙（Universe）时使用的水晶工具的碎片。

当你绑定其中一颗精确切割的水晶时，石头不会戴在身上，而会环绕头部运转（若你没有头部，则环绕身体另一处可见部位）。你可以收起一颗 万古石 ，使用一个交互动作；正在环绕的石头也能被从空中夺走，只需成功进行一次 @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{缴械} 动作，以你为目标。收起或取下的石头仍保持绑定，但其效果 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF] ，直到你让它再次环绕头部。

有多种类型的 万古石，每种都有不同外观和魔法效果。每个 万古石 插入特定物品后还会获得共鸣能力，例如具有万古特征的武器，或名为以下名称的古老魔法装置： 寻路石.

这个带有珍珠光泽、末端渐细的圆筒，会在你最需要时提供一口空气。你的屏息时间延长为两倍，且在对抗吸入型毒素的豁免上获得+1物品加值。其共鸣之力让你能够施放 @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.ShwUELLERVMtdjwE] ，作为每天一次的神术天生法术。

模组原文:
Staple items within the Azlanti Star Empire, these gemstones are popular status symbols for adventurers and wealthy collectors. Despite their myriad forms and functions, these stones are purportedly all fragments of crystal tools used by otherworldly entities to build the Universe in ancient times.

When you invest one of these precisely shaped crystals, the stone orbits your head (or another visible part of your anatomy if you don't have a head) instead of being worn on your body. You can stow an aeon stone with an Interact action, and an orbiting stone can be snatched out of the air with a successful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} action against you. A stowed or removed stone remains invested, but its effects are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF] until you return it to orbit your head again.

There are various types of aeon stones, each with a different appearance and magical effect. Each aeon stone also gains a resonant power when slotted into specific items, such as weapons with the aeon trait or antique magical devices called wayfinders.

This nacreous, tapered cylinder provides a breath of air when you need it most. You can hold your breath for twice as long, and you gain a +1 item bonus to saves against inhaled poisons. The resonant power allows you to cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.ShwUELLERVMtdjwE] as a divine innate spell once per day.

Staple items within the Azlanti Star Empire, these gemstones are popular status symbols for adventurers and wealthy collectors. Despite their myriad forms and functions, these stones are purportedly all fragments of crystal tools used by otherworldly entities to build the Universe in ancient times.

When you invest one of these precisely shaped crystals, the stone orbits your head (or another visible part of your anatomy if you don't have a head) instead of being worn on your body. You can stow an aeon stone with an Interact action, and an orbiting stone can be snatched out of the air with a successful @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Dt6B1slsBy8ipJu9]{Disarm} action against you. A stowed or removed stone remains invested, but its effects are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.conditions.Item.enA7BxAjBb7ns1iF] until you return it to orbit your head again.

There are various types of aeon stones, each with a different appearance and magical effect. Each aeon stone also gains a resonant power when slotted into specific items, such as weapons with the aeon trait or antique magical devices called wayfinders.

This nacreous, tapered cylinder provides a breath of air when you need it most. You can hold your breath for twice as long, and you gain a +1 item bonus to saves against inhaled poisons. The resonant power allows you to cast @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.ShwUELLERVMtdjwE] as a divine innate spell once per day.
